दिक्पति: दिक्पति m. (-तिः) A regent of a quarter of the universe, as the Sun of the east; Saturn of the west; Mars of the south; Mercury of the north; Venus of the south-east; Rāhu of the south-west; Candra of the north-west; and Jupiter of the north-east. E. दिश्, and पति master: see the next.
दिक्पाल: दिक्पाल m. (-लः) A regent of a quarter of the universe, as INDRA of the east; AGNI of the south-east; YAMA of the south; NAIRṚTA of the south-west; VARUṆA of the west; MARUT of the north-west; KUVERA of the north; ĪŚĀNA of the south-east. E. दिश्, and पाल who protects: this word is applicable to the Dikpatis, (see the last,) as that term is to these also.
दिक्शूल: दिक्शूल n. (-लं) An inauspicious planetary conjunction, as for the Sun and Venus to be in the west, &c. E. दिश्, and शूल a spear or stake.
दिगन्त: दिगन्त m. (-न्तः) The horizon. E. दिक्, and अन्त end.
दिगन्तर: दिगन्तर n. (-रं) Space, the atmosphere. E. दिक्, and अन्तर interval.
दिगन्तराल: दिगन्तराल n. (-लं) The sky, the atmosphere, space. E. दिक्, and अन्तराल interval.
दिगम्बर: दिगम्बर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Naked, unclad, unclothed. 2 Dressed in, or enveloped by the atmosphere, clouds, &c. m. (-रः) 1 A Bauddha mendicant, wearing coloured clothes, or going naked. 2 Any mendicant not wearing clothes. 3 Darkness. 4 A name of ŚIVA, (from his being naked.) 5 A Jain of one great division, which represents the images of their saints, either naked or plainly attired. f. (-री) A name of DURGĀ. E. दिक् inflection of दिश् space, अम्बर vestment; whose only garment is the atmosphere.
दिग्गज: दिग्गज m. (-जः) An elephant of a quarter or point of the compass, one of eight attached to the north, north-east, &c. supporting the globe. E. दिश् a quarter, गज an elephant.
दिग्दाह: दिग्दाह m. (-हः) Preternatural redness of the horizon, as if on fire. E. दिश्, and दाह burning.
दिग्ध: दिग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Smeared, anointed. m. (-ग्धः) 1 A poisoned arrow. 2 A name of fire. 3 Oil, unguent, oily substance. 4 A tale, true or false. E. दिह to smear or anoint, affix क्त.
दिग्वासस्: दिग्वासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Naked. m. (-साः) A name of ŚIVA. E. दिक् for दिश् space, and बासस् vesture: see दिगम्बर.
दिग्विजय: दिग्विजय m. (-यः) Subjugation of an extensive country, either in arms or controversy. E. दिश्, and विजय triumph.
दिग्विजयक्रम: दिग्विजयक्रम m. (-मः) Invesion, going forth to conquer the world. E. द्विग्विजय, and क्रम march.
दिग्विभाग: दिग्विभाग m. (-गः) A quarter or point of the compass. E. दिक्, and विभाग division.
दिग्विभावित: दिग्विभावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Famous, celebrated, known in all quarters. E. दिक, and विभावित made known.
दिग्व्यापिन्: दिग्व्यापिन् mfn. (-पी-पिनी-पि) Spreading through all space. E. दिक्, and व्यापिन् what pervades.
दिङ्मण्डल: दिङ्मण्डल n. (-लं) The circle of the heaven, or any point of the compass. E. दिश, and मण्डल sphere.
दिङ्मुख: दिङ्मुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Looking to, or facing any point or quarter. n. (-खं) Any part of the heavens. E. दिश्, and मुख face.
दिङ्नाग: दिङ्नाग m. (-गः) An elephant of the quarter: see दिग्गज.
दित: दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Cut, torn, divided. E. दो to cut, affix क्त.
दिति: दिति f. (-तिः) 1 One of the wives of KAŚYAPA, and mother of the Daityas or infernal race, opposed to the gods. 2 Cutting, splitting, dividing. m. (-तिः) A king, a prince. E. दो to cut, affix क्तिन्.
दितिज: दितिज m. (-जः) An Asura, a sort of Titan or giant. E. दिति as above, and ज born.
दितिसुत: दितिसुत m. (-तः) A Titan or giant. E. दिति as above, and सुत a son.
दित्य: दित्य m. (-त्यः) A Titan, a demon or giant. E. दिति as above, अण् affix; and the vowel unchanged: see दौत्य.
दित्सा: दित्सा f. (-त्सा) Desire or purpose to give. E. दा to give, desid. form, अङ् and टाप् affs.
दित्सु: दित्सु mfn. (-त्सुः-त्सुः-त्सु) Wishing to give. E. दा to give, desid. form, aff.
दिदृक्षमाण: दिदृक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wishing to see. E. दृश to see, desid. form, शानच् aff.
दिदृक्षा: दिदृक्षा f. (-क्षा) Desire or wish to see. E. दृश to see, desid. form, अङ् and टाप aff.
दिदृक्षु: दिदृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Desirous of seeing. E. दृश to see, desid. form, उ aff.
दिदृक्षावत्: दिदृक्षावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wishing to see. E. दिदृक्षा, and मतुप् aff.
दिदेविषत्: दिदेविषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing to play or sport. E. दिव to play, desid. form, शतृ aff.
दिद्युत्: दिद्युत् mfn. (-द्युत्) Shining, blazing, bright. E. द्यु to shine, शतृ affix, intens. form.
दिद्योतिषु: दिद्योतिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to shine. E. द्यु to shine, desid. form, उ aff.
दिधक्षमाण: दिधक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wishing to burn. E. दह to burn, desid. v. शानच् aff.
दिधक्षयत्: दिधक्षयत् mfn. (यन्-यन्त्री-यत्) Desiring to burn. E. दह to burn, desid. v. शतृ aff.
दिधि: दिधि f. (-धिः) Firmness, stability, fixed state of mind or being. E. धा to have, affix कि, and the root reiterated.
दिधिषाय्य: दिधिषाय्य m. (-य्यः) A pretended friend, an intimate. E. धा to have, Uṇādi affix आय्य, the root reduplicated, इट् and षुक augments.
दिधिषु: दिधिषु m. (-षुः) The second husband of a woman twice married. f. (-षुः) A virgin widow remarried. E. धा to have (sin), or धिष to be reproached, root reduplicate, affix कु or कू; in the first case, इट् and षुक augments; also दिधिषू.
दिधिषू: दिधिषू f. (-षूः) 1 A virgin widow remarried: see the preceding; also दिधीषू. 2 An elder sister unmarried, whose junior is a bride. m. (-षूः) 1 The husband of a woman married a second time: see दिधीषु. 2 Instability, want of firmness. E. दिधि firmness, षो to abandon, कू Uṇādi aff.
दिधिषूपति: दिधिषूपति m. (-तिः) The husband of a woman remarried. E. दिधिषू as above, and पति a husband.
दिन: दिन mn. (-नः-नं) A day. E. दी to waste, नक् affix, and the vowel made short; or दो to destroy, (darkness,) किनन् Uṇādi aff.
दिनकर: दिनकर m. (-रः) The sun. E. दिन day, and कर who makes.
दिनकरात्मजा: दिनकरात्मजा f. (-जा) The Yamunā or Jumna river. E. दिनकर the sun, and आत्मजा daughter.
दिनकृत्: दिनकृत् m. (-कृत्) The sun. E. दिन, and कृत् who makes.
दिनकेशव: दिनकेशव m. (-वः) Darkness. E. दिन day, and केशब hair.
दिनज्योतिस्: दिनज्योतिस् n. (-तिः) Sunshine, day-light. E. दिन day, and ज्योतिस् light.
दिनदुःखित: दिनदुःखित m. (-तः) The ruddy goose. E. दिन day, and दुःखित pained; regretting throughout the day, the approaching nocturnal separation from its female.
दिनप्रणी: दिनप्रणी m. (-णीः) The sun. E. दिन day, and प्रणी leading, bringing.
दिनबल: दिनबल m. (-लः) A name of certain signs of the zodiac, the fifth to the eighth; also the eleventh and twelfth. E. दिन, and बल strong.
दिनमणि: दिनमणि m. (-णिः) The sun. E. दिन day, and मणि jewel or gem.
दिनमूर्द्धन्: दिनमूर्द्धन् m. (-र्द्धा) The eastern mountain, behind which the sun is supposed to rise. E. दिन day, and मूर्द्धन् the forehead.
दिनांश: दिनांश m. (-शः) A portion of the day, a watch, an hour, or the three seasons of dawn, noon, and evening. E. दिन, and अंश part or portion.
दिनादि: दिनादि m. (-दिः) Dawn, day-break. E. दिन, and आदि commencement.
दिनान्त: दिनान्त m. (-न्तः) Evening, sun-set, close of day. E. दिन day, and अन्त end.
दिनान्तक: दिनान्तक m. (-कः) Darkness. E. दिन day, and अन्तक ender.
दिनारम्भ: दिनारम्भ m. (-म्भः) Morning. E. दिन, and आरम्भ beginning.
दिनावसान: दिनावसान n. (-नं) Evening, close of day. E. दिन day, and अवसान expiration.
दिनिका: दिनिका f. (-का) A day's wages, hire for a day or by the day. E. दिन a day, and ठक् aff.
दिभ: दिभ (इ) दिभि r. 10th cl. (दिम्भयति) To order, to direct.
दिम्प: दिम्प r. 1st and 10th cls. (दिम्पति-ते दिम्पयति-ते) To order, to command.
दिम्भ: दिम्भ r. 10th cl. (दिम्भति) 1 To command, to direct. 2 To collect.
दिलीप: दिलीप m. (-पः) The name of a king and ancestor of RĀMA. E. दिली said to be the barbarous name of Hastināpura or the modern Dehli, and प who protects or rules.
दिलीपराज्: दिलीपराज् m. (-राट्) King DILĪPA: see the preceding. E. दिलीप as above, and राज् a king.
दिव: दिव (उ) दिवु r. 4th cl. (दीव्यति) 1 To play, to sport, to play with, to romp or gambol. 2 To desire, to overcome, to be ambitious of surpassing, &c. 3 To deal, to traffic, to buy or sell. 4 To shine, to be splendid or beautiful. 5 To praise. 9 To be glad, to rejoice. 7 To be mad, to be wild or inflated with pride, passion, &c. 8 To be sleepy or sluggish. 9 To love, to desire. 10 To go. r. 10th cl. (देवयति) 1 To suffer pain. 2 To ask, to beseech or beg. 3 To move, to go. 4 (-ति ते) To lament, to wail, to mourn audibly. (इ) दिवि r. 1st cl. (दित्वति) 1 To please. 2 To be pleased.
दिव n. (-वं) 1 Heaven, paradise. 2 Heaven, sky, atmosphere. 3 A day. 4 A wood, a thicket. E. दिव to play, to shine, &c. affix कः see the preceding.
दिव्: दिव् f. (-द्यौः-दिवौ-दिवः) 1 Heaven, paradise. 2 Air, sky. E. दिव to play, affix क्विष्, where sport immortals; also दिव.
दिवन्: दिवन् m. (-वा) A day. E. दिव to play, Uṇādi affix अन्.
दिवस: दिवस mn. (-सः-सं) A day. E. दिव to play, कसच् Uṇādi aff.
दिवसकर: दिवसकर m. (-रः) The sun. E. दिवस day, and कर who makes.
दिवसमुख: दिवसमुख n. (-खं) Dawn, day-break. E. दिवस day, and मुख beginning.
दिवसात्यय: दिवसात्यय m. (-यः) Evening, close of day. E. दिवस, and अत्यय loss.
दिवसावसान: दिवसावसान n. (-नं) Evening, close of day. E. दिवस, and अवसान end.
दिवस्पति: दिवस्पति m. (-तिः) A name of INDRA, the Indian JOVE. E. दिवः of day, and पति lord, Divespiter.
दिवस्पृथिवी: दिवस्पृथिवी f. du. (-व्यौ) Heaven and earth. E. दिव heaven, and पृथिवी earth, स inserted for the sake of euphony.
दिवा: दिवा ind. By day, the day. E. दिव to play, &c. affix का.
दिवाकर: दिवाकर m. (-रः) 1 The sun. 2 A crow. 3 A flower, the sun-flower. E. दिवा the day, and कर who makes.
दिवाकीर्ति: दिवाकीर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) 1 A man of a low or impure caste, a Caṇḍāla. 2 A barber. 3 An owl. E. दिवा by day, and कीर्त्ति credit, (the barber is not allowed to operate at night,) or दिवा day, अकीर्त्ति disrepute; the Caṇḍāla and owl coming abroad only in the dark.
दिवाकीर्त्ति: दिवाकीर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) 1 A man of a low or impure caste, a Caṇḍāla. 2 A barber. 3 An owl. E. दिवा by day, and कीर्त्ति credit, (the barber is not allowed to operate at night,) or दिवा day, अकीर्त्ति disrepute; the Caṇḍāla and owl coming abroad only in the dark.
दिवाकृत: दिवाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done by day. E. दिवा, and कृत done.
दिवाचर: दिवाचर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Going about by day. E. दिवा, and चर who or what goes.
दिवाटन: दिवाटन m. (-नः) A crow. E. दिवा by day, अट to go, affix ल्यु.
दिवातन: दिवातन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Daily, diurnal, of or belonging to the day. E. दिवा by day, ट्यु aff.
दिवानिश: दिवानिश n. (-शं) Day and night. E. दिवा, and निशा night.
दिवान्ध: दिवान्ध mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं) Being blind by day. m. (-न्धः) An owl. E. दिवा by day, and अन्ध dark or blind.
दिवाभीत: दिवाभीत m. (-तः) 1 An owl. 2 A thief or house-breaker. 3 The white lotus, (कुमुदाकर;) perhaps any such flower, the petals of which open at night, and close in the day time. E. दिवा day, and भीत afraid.
दिवाभीति: दिवाभीति m. (-तिः) An owl. E. दिवा by day, and भीति fear: see the preceding.
दिवामणि: दिवामणि m. (-णिः) The sun. E. दिवा, and मणि a jewel.
दिवामध्य: दिवामध्य n. (-ध्यं) Mid-day, noon. E. दिवा, and मध्य middle.
दिवारात्र: दिवारात्र n. (-त्रं) A day and night. E. दिवा, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
दिवारात्रि: दिवारात्रि f. (-त्रिः) 1 Day or night. 2 A day and night. E. दिवा, and रात्रि night.
दिवासुप्त: दिवासुप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) A sleep by day. E. दिवा, and सुप्त asleep.
दिवि: दिवि m. (-विः) The blue jay. E. दिव to play, affix कि.
दिविज: दिविज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Celestial, heavenly, of heavenly origin. E. दिवि in heaven, and ज born.
दिविषद्: दिविषद् m. (-द्) A deity. E. दिवि in heaven, सद् to go, affix क्विप्.
दिविष्ठ: दिविष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Celestial, heavenly, situated in heaven. E. दिवि in heaven, and स्थ what stays.
दिवी: दिवी f. (-वी) A sort of insect; also उपजिह्विका. E. दिव to play, क affix, fem. affix ङीप्.
दिवोकस्: दिवोकस् m. (-काः) 1 A deity. 2 A kind of cuckoo, the Chataka: see दिवौकस्.
दिवोदास: दिवोदास m. (-सः) DIVODĀSA, a king so named, king of Benares, and founder of the Indian school of medicine. E. दिवः of heaven, दास the slave.
दिवोद्भव: दिवोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced in heaven. f. (-वा) Cardamoms. E. दिव heaven, उद्भव born.
दिवौकस्: दिवौकस् m. (-काः) 1 A deity. 2 The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 3 A deer. 4 A bee. 5 An elephant. E. दिव heaven, ether, ओकस् a mansion; also with the vowel unaltered दिवोकस्.
दिव्य: दिव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 Divine, celestial. 2 Beautiful, agreeable, charming. m. (-व्यः) 1 Barley. 2 A fragrant resin, (Bdellium.) 3 The divine character or property. f. (-व्या) Emblic myrobalan. n. (-व्यं) 1 Cloves. 2 A sort of Sandal. 3 An ordeal. 4 An oath. E. द्यु the sky or heaven, and यत् aff.
दिव्यकारिन्: दिव्यकारिन् m. (-री) One who undergoes an ordeal. E. दिव्य, and कारिन् who makes.
दिव्यगन्ध: दिव्यगन्ध m. (-न्धः) Sulphur. n. (-न्धं) Cloves. f. (-न्धा) Large cardamoms. E. दिव्य, and गन्ध smell.
दिव्यगायन: दिव्यगायन m. (-नः) A Gandharba or singer of heaven. E. दिव्य -divine, and गायन a singer.
दिव्यचक्षुस्: दिव्यचक्षुस् mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षु-क्षुः) 1 Beautiful-eyed. 2 Blind. m. (-क्षुः) 1 A sort of perfume. 2 A monkey. n. (-क्षुः) The faculty of seeing what is invisible by the human eye. E. दिव्य divine, and चक्षुस् an eye.
दिव्यदोहद: दिव्यदोहद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Fit for an offering or oblation. E. दिव्य divine, and दोहद wish, that which is the subject of a deity's desires.
दिव्यधर्मिन्: दिव्यधर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) Virtuous, agreeable. E. दिव्य, and धर्म्मिन् virtuous.
दिव्यधर्म्मिन्: दिव्यधर्म्मिन् mfn. (-र्म्मी-र्म्मिणी-र्म्मि) Virtuous, agreeable. E. दिव्य, and धर्म्मिन् virtuous.
दिव्यपञ्चामृत: दिव्यपञ्चामृत n. (-तं) A mixture of five articles, ghee, curds, milk, butter, and sugar. E. दिव्य divine, पञ्च five, and अमृत ambrosia.
दिव्यरत्न: दिव्यरत्न n. (-त्वं) The fabulous gem Cintāmaṇi. E. दिव्य divine, and रत्न jewel.
दिव्यरथ: दिव्यरथ m. (-थः) The car or vehicle of any deity. E. दिव्य divine, रथ a carriage.
दिव्यरस: दिव्यरस m. (-सः) Quicksilver. E. दिव्य divine, and रस juice.
दिव्यवस्त्र: दिव्यवस्त्र mfn. (-स्त्रः-स्त्रा-स्त्रं) 1 Clothed or invested in celestial raiment. 2 Handsomely dressed. m. (-स्त्रः) A plant, commonly Sūryaśobhā, a sort of sun-flower. E. दिव्य divine, वस्त्र cloth or clothes.
दिव्यादिव्या: दिव्यादिव्या f. (-व्या) The heroine of a poem, as SĪTĀ, &c. of mixed origin or character, a demigoddess. E. दिव्य divine, अदिव्य not divine, partaking of both natures.
दिव्योघ: दिव्योघ m. (-घः) A form of ŚIVA, worshipped by the Tāntrikas. E. दिव्य, and ओघ heap.
दिव्योदक: दिव्योदक n. (-कं) Rain water, dew, &c. E. दिव्य heavenly, and उदक water.
दिव्योपपादुक: दिव्योपपादुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Divine, celestial, of heavenly birth or being. E. दिव्य divine, पद to go, with उप prefixed, and उकञ् aff.
दिश: दिश (औ) दिशौ r. 6th cl. (दिशति-ते) 1 To show, to exhibit, to explain or make intelligible. 2 To order, to command, to direct or send. 3 To say, to speak. 4 To give. With अप prefixed, To change, to disguise. With आङ्, 1 To order or command. 2 To show. 3 To summons. With उद्, 1 To proclaim, to make known or public. 2 To show. With उप, To point out (literally or metaphorically), to show, to advise. With निर्, 1 To speak aloud. 2 To specify, to show. With प्र, To appoint, to order. With प्रति and सम्, To command, to return, to send back. With वि and अप, To plead in excuse, to state as a plea or pretext. With वि and निर्, To declare. With सम्, 1 To exhibit, to show, &c. 2 To communicate as news or information. With सम् and आङ्, To approve, to permit. With सम and उप, To point out at a distance, as with the finger.
दिश्: दिश् f. (-दिक्-दिशौ-दिशः) Region, space, quarter, part. E. दिश to shew, affix क्विन्; also with टाप् added, दिशा, f. (-शा) or with ङीप्, द्रिशी.
दिशस्: दिशस् f. (-शाः) Region, quarter. E. दिश, and असुन् affix: see the preceding.
दिश्य: दिश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) Situated, bearing, lying in a particular tract or quarter, as पर्व्वदिश्य eastern, bearing east. E. दिश् a quarter, यत् aff.
दिष्ट: दिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Shown, pointed out. 2 Delineated, described. 3 Counselled, advised, enjoined. m. (-ष्टः) 1 Time. 2 A sort of Curcuma: see दारुहरिद्रा. n. (-ष्टं) Fate, destiny, fortune, good or ill luck. E. दिश् to show, affix क्त.
दिष्टान्त: दिष्टान्त m. (-न्तः) Death, dying. E. दिष्ट fortune, and अन्त end.
दिष्टि: दिष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Pleasure, happiness. 2 A sort of measure. E. दिश् to point out, affix क्तिन्.
दिष्ट्या: दिष्ट्या ind. An exclamation, indicative of joy or auspiciousness, luckily, fortunately. E. दिश् pointing out, स्त्यै to sound, affix क्विप्.
दिष्णु: दिष्णु mfn. (-ष्णुः-ष्णुः-ष्णु) Giving, one who gives, a donor. E. दा to give, इष्णु Uṇādi affix: see देष्णु.
दिह: दिह (औ) दिहौ r. 2nd cl. (दिग्धे) 1 To increase, to augment, to accumulate. 2 To smear.
दी: दी r. 4th cl. (ओ ङ) ओदीङ (दीयते) To waste, to diminish, to be reduced, to decay.
दी f. (दीः) Wasting, destruction. E. दी to waste, क्विप् aff.
दीक्ष: दीक्ष r. 1st cl. (दीक्षति) 1 To be shaved. 2 To perform a sacrifice. 3 To initiate. 4 To teach religious observances. 4 To be self-restrained.
दीक्षणीयेष्टि: दीक्षणीयेष्टि f. (-ष्टि) A particular sacrifice, that preceded by the Dīkṣa: see the next. E. दीक्षा as below, छ affix, and इष्टि a sacrifice.
दीक्षा: दीक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 Sacrificing, offering oblations. 2 Worshipping in general. 3 Engaging in a course of austerities. 4 Certain ceremonies preliminary to a sacrifice. 5 Receiving the initiatory Mantra or incantation. E. दा to give, (knowledge,) and क्षि to destroy, (sin;) deriv. irr. or दीक्ष to initiate, &c. affix अङ् and टाप्.
दीक्षान्त: दीक्षान्त m. (-न्तः) A supplementary sacrifice, one made to atone for any defects in a preceding one. E. दिक्षा sacrifice, and अन्त completion, end.
दीक्षित: दीक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Initiated. 2 Performed, (as the Dīkṣa ceremony.) 3 One by whom the preparatory ceremonies have been observed. m. (-तः) 1 An assemblage of priests for peculiar ceremonies, or for any sacrifice. 2 The pupil of an ascetick. E. दीक्ष to perform a sacrifice or to be initiated, affix क्त.
दीक्षितृ: दीक्षितृ m. (-ता) A spiritual father, the communicator of the initiatory Mantra or prayer. E. दीक्ष to sacrifice, &c. तृच् aff.
दीद: दीद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Destroying. E. दी, and द who or what gives.
दीदिवि: दीदिवि mfn. (-विः-विः-वि) Risen, ascended. mn. (-विः-वि) Boiled rice. m. (-विः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. दिव to play, Uṇādi affix क्विन्, the radical reduplicate, deriv. irr.
दीधिति: दीधिति f. (-तिः) 1 A ray of light, a sun or a moonbeam. 2 Light in general. E. दीधी to shine, affix क्तिच्.
दीधी: दीधी (ङ्) दीधीङ् r. 2nd cl. (दीधीते) 1 To shine. 2 To play or sport.
दीन: दीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Poor, indigent, needy, distressed. 2 Afraid, frightened, timid. f. (-ना) A mouse or shrew. E. दी to waste or decay, affix क्त, deriv. irr. or दी as before, Uṇādi affix नक्.
दीनचेतन: दीनचेतन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Distressed, dejected. E. दीन, and चेतन feeling.
दीनमुख: दीनमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Down-cast, of melancholy aspect. E. दीन, and मुख mouth.
दीनार: दीनार m. (-रः) 1 A gold ornament. 2 A seal. 3 A weight of gold, variously stated as two Kāṣṭhas, one Pala of thirtytwo Reitis, and also as the large Pala or hundred and eight Suvarṇas. 4 A coin, a Dinar. E. दीन a pauper, and ऋ to go; what is given to the poor; or दी to waste, Uṇādi affix आरन्, and नुट् augment.
दीप: दीप r. 4th cl. (ई ऋ) ऋदीपी (दीप्यते) To shine, to blaze, to be luminous or light.
दीप m. (-पः) A lamp. E. दीप to shine, affix क or घञ्.
दीपक: दीपक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Making luminous or beautiful. 2 Kindling, inflaming. 3 Exciting, rendering intense, (a feeling, &c.) 4 Tonic, stimulant. m. (-कः) 1 An aromatick seed, (Ligusticum ajväen, Rox.) 2 Small cumin. 3 Celosia cristata. 4 Saffron. 5 A lamp. 6 A falcon. 7 A name of KĀMA. 8 One of the Rāgas or modes of music. f. (-पिका) 1 One of the Rāgiṇīs, or female personifications of the musical modes. 2 A title of various books, (the illustrator, the illuminator.) 3 Moonlight. n. (-कं) A figure of rhetoric, dilating upon an idea, or accumulation of expressions tending to one object. E. दीप to shine, in the causal form, affix ण्वुल्.
दीपकिट्ट: दीपकिट्ट n. (-ट्टं) Lamp black, soot. E. दीप a lamp, and किट्ट sediment.
दीपकूपी: दीपकूपी f. (-पी) The wick of a lamp. E. दीप a lamp, and कूप a well.
दीपखोरी: दीपखोरी f. (-री) The wick of a lamp. E. दीप light, खुड to divide, affix अच्, and ड changed to र.
दीपध्वज: दीपध्वज mn. (-जः-जं) Lamp black, the condensed smoke or soot of a lamp. E. दीप a lamp, and ध्वज symbol.
दीपन: दीपन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Inflaming, light or heat-exciting. 2 Tonic, stimulant. n. (-नं) 1 Inflaming, lighting. 2 Stimulating, exciting. 3 A root, commonly Tagara. 4 Saffron. mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) An aromatick seed, (Ligusticum ajväen.) m. (-नः) 1 A sort of potherb, commonly Śaliñca, (Achyranthes triandra, Rox.) 2 Celosia cristata. 3 Cassia tora. E. दीप to shine, in the causal form, and युच् or ल्युट् aff.
दीपनीय: दीपनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be lighted, to be inflamed. 2 To be excited or stimulated. m. (-यः) 1 An aromatick seed, (Ligusticum ajväen, Rox.) 2 A stimulant drug, as pepper of various kinds, &c. E. दीप to shine, अनीयर् aff.
दीपपादप: दीपपादप m. (-पः) A lampstand, a candlestick. E. दीप, and पादप a tree.
दीपपुष्प: दीपपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The Champac, (Michelia champaca.) E. दीप enkindling, (passion,) and पुष्प a flower.
दीपमाला: दीपमाला f. (-ला) A row of lamps, an illumination. E. दीप, and माला a garland; also दीपमालिका.
दीपयत्: दीपयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Illuminating, inflaming. E. दीप to kindle, causal form, शतृ aff.
दीपवृक्ष: दीपवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The stand or stem of a lamp, a candlestick. E. दीप a lamp, and वृक्ष a tree; also दीपवृक्षक.
दीपशिखा: दीपशिखा f. (-खा) 1 Lamp black, especially considered as applicable to the eyes, to darken the lashes, &c. 2 The flame of a lamp. E. दीप a lamp, and शिखा a crest.
दीपशृङ्खला: दीपशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A row or string of lamps. E. दीप, and शृङ्खला a chain.
दीपान्विता: दीपान्विता f. (-ता) A festival: see the next. E. दीप, and अन्वित having.
दीपाली: दीपाली f. (-ली) 1 The day of new moon in the month Aśvin or Kārttika, (September-October,) a festival with nocturnal illuminations in honor of KĀRTTIKEYA; the Divalī, as it is usually termed. 2 A row or range of lamps. E. दीप a lamp, and आली a line; also दीपावली the same.
दीपित: दीपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Illuminated, irradiated. 2 Excited, inflamed. 3 Manifested. E. दीप to kindle, causal form, क्त aff.
दीपितृ: दीपितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) An illuminator, an enlightener, shining, irradiating. E. दीप to kindle, &c. तृच् aff.
दीप्त: दीप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Luminous, splendid, radiant. 2 Blazing, glowing. 3 Burnt. n. (-प्तं) 1 Gold. 3 Asafoetida. m. (-प्तः) 1 A lion. 2 A lime. f. (-प्ता) A plant: see लाङ्गलिकी. E. दीप to blaze, to shine, affix क्त.
दीप्तक: दीप्तक m. (-कः) Gold. E. कन् added to the preceding.
दीप्तजिह्वा: दीप्तजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A fox. E. दीप्त shining, fiery, and जिह्वा tongue.
दीप्तपिङ्गल: दीप्तपिङ्गल m. (-लः) A lion. E. दीप्त shining, and पिङ्गल tawny.
दीप्तरस: दीप्तरस m. (-सः) An earth-worm. E. दीप्त shining, and रस juice.
दीप्तलोचन: दीप्तलोचन m. (-नः) A cat. E. दीप्त shining, and लोचन an eye.
दीप्तलोह: दीप्तलोह m. (-हः) Bell metal. E. दीप्त shining, and लोह iron.
दीप्ताक्ष: दीप्ताक्ष m. (-क्षः) 1 A cat. 2 A peacock. E. दीप्त glowing, and अक्ष the eye.
दीप्ताग्नि: दीप्ताग्नि mfn. (-ग्निः-ग्निः-ग्नि) 1 Of good digestion. 2 Kindled, fed, (as fire.) m. (-ग्निः) A name of the saint AGASTYA. E. दीप्त excited, and अग्नि fire, or the appetite.
दीप्ताङ्ग: दीप्ताङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A peacock. E. दीप्त, and अङ्ग body.
दीप्ति: दीप्ति f. (-प्तिः) 1 Light, lustre, splendour. 2 Beauty. 3 The swift flight of an arrow. 4 A property of women, extreme loveliness, brilliant beauty. 5 Lac. 6 Bell metal. E. दीप to shine, affix क्तिन्.
दीप्तिमत्: दीप्तिमत् m. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Shining, radiant. 2 Blazing, flaming. E. दीप्त, and मतुप् aff.
दीप्तोपल: दीप्तोपल m. (-लः) The sun-gem, a crystalline lens. E. दीप्त shining, and उपल a stone.
दीप्य: दीप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) 1 To be kindled or inflamed. 2 To be stimulated. m. (-प्यः) 1 A plant, (Celosia cristata.) 2 An aromatic seed, (Ligusticum ajväen.) E. दीप, and यत् affix: see दीप; also with कन् added दीप्यकः see दीपक.
दीप्यमान: दीप्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining, radiant, irradiating. E. दीप to shine, शानच् aff.
दीप्र: दीप्र mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्तं) Light, luminous. E. दीप to shine, affix र.
दीप्रास्त्रधर: दीप्रास्त्रधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Armed with shining weapons; well accoutred. E. दीप light, अख arms, धृ to hold.
दीर्घ: दीर्घ mfn. (-र्घः-र्घा-र्घं) Long, applied either to space or time. m. (-र्धः) 1 The Śāl tree. 2 A long vowel. 3 The 5th, 6th, 7th, or 8th sign of the zodiac. E. दॄ to divide or send, affix घञ्.
दीर्घकण्ठक: दीर्घकण्ठक m. (-कः) A sort of crane, the Vaka, (Ardea nivea.) E. दीर्घ long, कण्ठ throat, and कन् added.
दीर्घकन्धर: दीर्घकन्धर m. (-रः) A sort of crane, (Ardea nivea.) E. दीर्घ, and कन्धर neck.
दीर्घकाल: दीर्घकाल n. (-लं) A long time, a long period. E. दीर्घ, and काल time.
दीर्घकाष्ठ: दीर्घकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A spar, a beam, a long piece of timber. E. दीर्घ, and काष्ठ wood.
दीर्घकील: दीर्घकील m. (-लः) A tree, (Alangium hexapetalum.) E. दीर्घ long, कील a stem or stake; also with कन्, दीर्घकीलक.
दीर्घकेश: दीर्घकेश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Long-haired. m. (-शः) A bear. E. दीर्घ, and केश hair.
दीर्घकोशिका: दीर्घकोशिका f. (का) A cockle; also दीर्घ, कोशी, &c. see the next.
दीर्घकोषिका: दीर्घकोषिका f. (-का) A cockle. E. दीर्घ long, कोश or कोष a sheath or shell, affix ङीप्, दीर्घकोषी, or दीर्घकोशी and कन् with the fem. form added, दीर्घकोशिका,-षिका.
दीर्घगति: दीर्घगति m. (-तिः) A camel. E. दीर्घ, and गति going.
दीर्घग्रीव: दीर्घग्रीव m. (-वः) 1 A camel. 2 A kind of curlew. E. दीर्घ long, and ग्रीवा a neck.
दीर्घघाटिक: दीर्घघाटिक m. (-कः) A camel. E. दीर्घ long, घाटा the neck, affix ठन्.
दीर्घजङ्गल: दीर्घजङ्गल m. (-लः) A kind of fish, commonly Bhangan. E. दीर्घ long, and जङ्गल desert.
दीर्घजङ्घ: दीर्घजङ्घ mfn. (-ङ्घः-ङ्घा-ङ्घं) Long-thighed. m. (-ङ्घः) 1 A crane. 2 A camel. E. दीर्घ long, and जङ्घा a thigh.
दीर्घजिह्व: दीर्घजिह्व m. (-ह्वः) A snake. E. दीर्घ long, and जिह्वा a tongue.
दीर्घजीव: दीर्घजीव m. (-वः) Long life. E. दीर्घ, and जीव life; also दीर्घजीवित.
दीर्घजीविन्: दीर्घजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living or existing a long time. E. दीर्घ, and जीविन् who lives.
दीर्घतनु: दीर्घतनु mfn. (-नुः-नुः-नु) Tall, long. E. दीर्घ, and तनु body.
दीर्घतरु: दीर्घतरु m. (-रुः) The Tāla or palm tree. E. दीर्घ long, and तरु a tree.
दीर्घतिमिषा: दीर्घतिमिषा f. (-षा) A kind of cucumber: see कर्क्कटी.
दीर्घतुण्डा: दीर्घतुण्डा f. (-ण्डा) The musk shrew. E. दीर्घ, and तुण्डा a snout.
दीर्घदण्ड: दीर्घदण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The castor oil tree. E. दीर्घ long, दण्ड a stick or stem; also with कन् added, दीर्घदण्डकः
दीर्घदर्शिन्: दीर्घदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिणी-र्शि) Far-seeing, provident, wise. m. (-र्शी) 1 A wise or learned man, a seer, a prophet. 2 A vulture. 3 A bean. E. दीर्घ long, दृश to see, affix णिनि.
दीर्घदृष्टि: दीर्घदृष्टि m. (-ष्टिः) A wise or provident man; also, mfn. Wise, provident, far-seeing. E. दीर्घ long, and दृष्टि sight.
दीर्घद्रु: दीर्घद्रु m. (-द्रुः) The palm tree. E. दीर्घ long, and द्रु a tree.
दीर्घनाद: दीर्घनाद m. (-दः) A conch shell. E. दीर्घ, and नाद sound.
दीर्घनिद्रा: दीर्घनिद्रा f. (-द्रा) Death. E. दीर्घ long, and निद्रा sleep.
दीर्घनिश्वस्य: दीर्घनिश्वस्य ind. Sighing or having sighed deeply. E. दीर्घ, and निश्वस्य having sighed.
दीर्घनिश्वास: दीर्घनिश्वास m. (-सः) A long or deep drawn sigh. E. दीर्घ, and निश्वास a sigh.
दीर्घपक्ष: दीर्घपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The fork-tailed shrike. E. दीर्घ, and पक्ष a wing.
दीर्घपत्र: दीर्घपत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्री-त्रं) Long-leaved longifolium. m. (-त्रः) Garlic. f. (-त्रा) 1 A sort of Eugenia. 2 A kind of Chakuliya. E. दीर्घ long, and पत्र a leaf.
दीर्घपत्रक: दीर्घपत्रक m. (-कः) 1 A thorny plant: see करीर. 2 A kind of Bassia growing in marshy places. 3 Garlic. E. दीर्घ long, पत्र a leaf, and कन् added.
दीर्घपर्ण: दीर्घपर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णी-र्णं) Long-leaved longifolium. E. दीर्घ, and पर्ण a leaf.
दीर्घपल्लव: दीर्घपल्लव mfn. (-वः-वा-वी-वं) Having long shoots or tendrils. m. (-वः) The Śaṇa plant, (Crotolaria juneca.) E. दीर्घ, and पल्लव a shoot.
दीर्घपादप: दीर्घपादप m. (-पः) 1 The cocoanut tree. 2 The betelnut tree. E. दीर्घ, and पादप a tree.
दीर्घपाद्: दीर्घपाद् m. (-द् or त्) A heron. E. दीर्घ long, and पाद for पद a foot; also with a final vowel दीर्घपाद m. (-दः)
दीर्घपृष्ठ: दीर्घपृष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A snake. E. दीर्घ long, and पृष्ठ back.
दीर्घफल: दीर्घफल n. (-लं) A plant, (Cassia fistula.) E. दीर्घ long, and फल fruit.
दीर्घमारुत: दीर्घमारुत m. (-तः) An elephant. E. दीर्घ long, मारुत wind er breath.
दीर्घमुख: दीर्घमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Long-faced. E. दीर्घ, and मुख the face.
दीर्घमूल: दीर्घमूल mfn. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Having a long root. m. (-लः) A kind of Bilva tree. n. (-लं) A sort of sensitive plant. f. (-ला) 1 A creeper, (Echites frutescens:) see श्यामलता. 2 A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum;) also Śālaparṇī. f. (-ली) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. दीर्घ long, मूल a root.
दीर्घरत: दीर्घरत m. (-तः) A hog. E. दीर्घ long, and रत copulation.
दीर्घरद: दीर्घरद m. (-दः) A hog. E. दीर्घ long, and रद a tooth.
दीर्घरसन: दीर्घरसन m. (-नः) A snake. E. दीर्घ long, and रसना a tongue.
दीर्घरात्र: दीर्घरात्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A long period. 2 A long night. E. दीर्घ long, and रात्र for रात्रि night.
दीर्घराव: दीर्घराव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Making a long continued noise, yelling, howling. E. दीर्घ, and राव cry.
दीर्घरोगिन्: दीर्घरोगिन् mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि) Being long ill. E. दीर्घ, and रोगिन् sick.
दीर्घरोमन्: दीर्घरोमन् m. (-मा) A bear. E. दीर्घ long, रोमन् hair of the body.
दीर्घरोहिषक: दीर्घरोहिषक n. (-कं) A fragrant sort of grass. E. दीर्घ, and रोहिषक another sort.
दीर्घवंश: दीर्घवंश mfn. (-शः-शा-शं) 1 Having a long staff or stick. 2 Being of an ancient family. m. (-शः) A reed. E. दीर्घ, and वंश a race, a bambu.
दीर्घवक्त्र: दीर्घवक्त्र m. (-क्त्रः) An elephant. E. दीर्घ long, and वक्त्र face.
दीर्घवर्ण: दीर्घवर्ण m. (-र्णः) A long vowel. E. दीर्घ, and वर्ण a letter.
दीर्घवर्त्मन्: दीर्घवर्त्मन् m. (-र्त्मा) A long road, a long journey. E. दीर्घ, and वर्त्मन् a path.
दीर्घवृन्त: दीर्घवृन्त m. (-न्तः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. दीर्घ long, and वृन्त stalk; with कन् added दीर्घवृन्तक.
दीर्घवृन्तिका: दीर्घवृन्तिका f. (-का) A plant, (Mimosa octandra.) E. दीर्घ long, and वृन्त a stalk, कन् affix, with the fem. form.
दीर्घशाख: दीर्घशाख m. (-खः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. दीर्घ long, and शाखा a branch.
दीर्घसक्थ: दीर्घसक्थ mfn. (-क्थः-क्था-क्थं) Long-thighed. E. दीर्घ long, and सक्थि a thigh, affix अच्; figuratively used, the compound retains its proper final, as दीर्घसक्थि चक्रं a long-spoked wheel.
दीर्घसत्र: दीर्घसत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 A sort of religious ceremony, one of long continuance. 2 A place of pilgrimage. E. दीर्घ long, सत्र sacrifice, &c.
दीर्घसन्ध्यत्व: दीर्घसन्ध्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Long-continued observance of the chief daily rites. E. दीर्घ, and सन्ध्या the morning, noon, and evening oblation, त्व aff.
दीर्घसुरत: दीर्घसुरत m. (-तः) A dog. E. दीर्घ long, and सुरत coition.
दीर्घसूत्र: दीर्घसूत्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं) Dilatory, slow, tedious. E. दीर्घ long, and सूत्र line or thread.
दीर्घसूत्रता: दीर्घसूत्रता f. (-ता) Dilatoriness, tediousness. E. दीर्घसूत्र, and तल् added; also with त्व, दीर्घसूत्रत्व.
दीर्घसूत्रिन्: दीर्घसूत्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) Dilatory. E. दीर्घ, and सूत्रिन् having a line or thread.
दीर्घस्वर: दीर्घस्वर m. (-रः) 1 A long vowel. 2 A long note, a minim or semibreve. E. दीर्घ, and स्वर a sound.
दीर्घाध्वग: दीर्घाध्वग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) A letter carrier, a messenger, an express. m. (-गः) A camel. E. दीर्घ long, अध्वन् a road, and ग who goes.
दीर्घाध्वन्: दीर्घाध्वन् n. (-ध्व) A long journey. E. दीर्घ, and अध्वन् a road.
दीर्घामय: दीर्घामय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Long ill. E. दीर्घ, and आमय sickness.
दीर्घायुध: दीर्घायुध m. (-धः) 1 A spear, a javelin. 2 A hog. E. दीर्घ long, and आयुध weapon, or one so armed.
दीर्घायुस्: दीर्घायुस् mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Long-lived. m. (-युः) 1 The saint MĀRKAṆḌEYA. 2 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 3 A crow. 4 A tree: see जीवक. n. (-यु) Long life. E. दीर्घ long, and आयुस् life.
दीर्घायुष्य: दीर्घायुष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Long-lived. E. दीर्घ, and आयुष्य lived.
दीर्घिका: दीर्घिका f. (-का) A large and long pond. E. दीर्घ long, affix कन्, fem. form.
दीर्ण: दीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Torn, rent, sundered. 2 Frightened, afraid. E. दॄ to tear, affix क्त, deriv. irr.
दीवि: दीवि m. (-विः) The blue jay. E. see दिवि and किकीदिवि, &c.
दीव्यत्: दीव्यत् mfn. (-व्यन्-व्यती-व्यत्) Playing, sporting. E. दिव play, शतृ aff.
दीव्यमान: दीव्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Throwing, darting, shooting. 2 Playing. E. दिव to play, शानच् aff.
दु: दु r. 1st cl. (दवति) To go, to move. (दुनोति) r. 5th cl. (ओ, टु) ओटुटु 1 To be in pain, to burn morally or figuratively. 2 To cause pain, anxiety, &c. 3 To burn, to heat.
दुःख: दुःख r. 10th cl. (दुःखयति) To give pain.
दुःख n. (-खं) 1 Pain, sorrow, affliction, distress, unhappiness. 2 The world. 3 Difficulty, trouble. E. दुःख to give pain, affix अच्; or दु bad, and ख्या to call; or खन to dig, ड aff.
दुःखकर: दुःखकर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Causing pain. 2 Afflicting, occasioning sorrow or trouble. E. दुःख, and कर what makes.
दुःखच्छिन्न: दुःखछिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Cut with difficulty, tough, hard. 2 Afflicted, pained, distressed. E. दुःख, and छिन्न cut.
दुःखछिन्न: दुःखछिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) 1 Cut with difficulty, tough, hard. 2 Afflicted, pained, distressed. E. दुःख, and छिन्न cut.
दुःखच्छेद्य: दुःखछेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 To be cut with difficulty, tough, hard. 2 To be overcome with difficulty. 3 To be hart or pained by, (affliction, &c.) E. दुःख, and छेद्य to be cut.
दुःखछेद्य: दुःखछेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) 1 To be cut with difficulty, tough, hard. 2 To be overcome with difficulty. 3 To be hart or pained by, (affliction, &c.) E. दुःख, and छेद्य to be cut.
दुःखजीविन्: दुःखजीविन् mfn. (-वी-विनी-वि) Living in pain or distress. E. दुःख, and जीविन् living.
दुःखदग्ध: दुःखदग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) Afflicted, pained, distressed. E. दुःख, and दग्ध burnt.
दुःखदोह्या: दुःखदोह्या f. (-ह्या) A cow difficult to be milked. E. दुःख trouble, दोह्य to be milked.
दुःखप्राय: दुःखप्राय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Full of trouble or pain. E. दुःख, and प्राय abundant.
दुःखबहुल: दुःखबहुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Painful, distressful, abounding with trouble, &c. E. दुःख, and बहुल much.
दुःखभागिन्: दुःखभागिन् mfn. (-गी-गिनी-गि) Suffering pain, having pain as their portion. E. दुःख, and भागिन् who shares.
दुःखयोग: दुःखयोग m. (-गः) Occurrence or incidence of trouble, pain, &c. E. दुःख, and योग union.
दुःखलभ्य: दुःखलभ्य mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं) To be obtained or effected with difficulty. E. दुःख, and लभ्य obtainable.
दुःखसंवर्द्धित: दुःखसंवर्द्धित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Reared with trouble and difficulty. E. दुःस्व, and संवर्द्धित raised.
दुःखसंयोग: दुःखसंयोग m. (-गः) Accession or presence of pain, distress, &c. E. दुःख, and संयोग union.
दुःखसंस्थिति: दुःखसंस्थिति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Wretched, poor, miserable. E. दुःख, and संस्थिति condition.
दुःखसागर: दुःखसागर m. (-रः) 1 Deep distress. 2 The world. E. दुःख, and सागर an ocean.
दुःखहन्: दुःखहन् mfn. (-हा-हा-ह) Removing pain. E. दुःख, and हन् who or what destroys.
दुःखातीत: दुःखातीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Freed from pain. E. दुःख, and अतीत passed.
दुःखान्वित: दुःखान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pained, afflicted, distressed. E. दुःख, and अन्वित having.
दुःखार्त: दुःखार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Afflicted, pained, distressed. E. दुःख, and आर्त्त pained.
दुःखार्त्त: दुःखार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Afflicted, pained, distressed. E. दुःख, and आर्त्त pained.
दुःखित: दुःखित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pained, suffering pain. n. (-तं) Pain, distress, trouble. E. दुःख to give pain, affix क्त.
दुःखिन्: दुःखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) 1 Suffering pain, sorrowing, afflicted. 2 Difficult, painful. E. दुःख, and इनि aff.
दुःखोपेत: दुःखोपेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suffering distress, &c. E. दुःख, and उपेत gone to.
दुःप्राप: दुःप्राप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Difficult of attainment. E. दुर्, and प्राप obtaining; also दुष्प्राप.
दुःप्राप्य: दुःप्राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Difficult of attainment. E. दुर्, and प्राप्य obtainable: also दुष्प्राप्य.
दुःशासन: दुःशासन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Ungovernable, ill managed, intractable. E. दुर्, and शासन an edict.
दुःशील: दुःशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Ill behaved, reprobate, abandoned. E. दुर्, and शील behaviour.
दुःषमम्: दुःषमम् ind. Improperly, unseasonably, unfitly. E. दुर् bad, सम् equal to; स changed to ष.
दुःषूति: दुःषूति m. (-तिः) A wicked son. E. दुर्, सूति progeny.
दुःसन्धान: दुःसन्धान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Not coherent, difficult to be united or joined. E. दुर्, and सन्धान uniting.
दुःसम: दुःसम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Improper, unseasonable. E. दुर् bad, ill, सम same.
दुःसह: दुःसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Intolerable, difficult to be borne. E. दुर्, and सह what is borne.
दुःसाधिन्: दुःसाधिन् m. (-धी) A porter, a warder. E. दुर् ill, साध to accomplish, affix णिनि.
दुःसाध्य: दुःसाध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 Difficult, arduous, not easily accomplished. 2 Incurable or difficult of cure. E. दुर् ill, साध to accomplish, affix यत्.
दुःस्थ: दुःस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Poor, ill conditioned, badly situated. 2 Ignorant, unwise, a fool. 3 Suffering pain or affliction, distressed, unhappy. 4 Covetous. m. (-स्थः) Pain, trouble. E. दुर् bad, ill, स्था to be or exist, affix ड.
दुःस्थिति: दुःस्थिति f. (-तिः) 1 Unsteadiness, instability. 2 Unhappiness, ill fortune or condition. E. दुर् bad, &c. स्थिति staying, state.
दुःस्पर्श: दुःस्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Difficult or unfit to be touched. m. (-र्शः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhagi.) f. (-र्शा) A prickly sort of nightshade. E. दुर् bad, स्पृश to touch, affix खल्, fem. affix टाप्.
दुःस्फोट: दुःस्फोट m. (-टः) A sort of weapon. E. दुर् ill, स्फुट to bear, affix अच्.
दुकूल: दुकूल n. (-लं) 1 Wove silk. 2 Very fine cloth or raiment. E. टु for दुर् ill, कूल to cover, affix क; or दु to heat, to keep hot, उलच् affix, and कू or गू augment, whence also दुगल.
दुगूल: दुगूल n. (-लं) Wove silk: see the preceding.
दुग्ध: दुग्ध mfn. (-ग्धः-ग्धा-ग्धं) 1 Filled, full. 2 Milked. n. (-ग्धं) 1 Milk. 2 Milking. f. (-ग्धी) A medicinal plant; also क्षीरी. E. दुह to milk, affix क्त.
दुग्धकूपिका: दुग्धकूपिका f. (-का) A sort of cake made of ground rice, and milk, &c. fried with ghee.
दुग्धता: दुग्धता f. (-ता) Milkiness, the nature of milk. E. तल् added to दुग्ध; also with त्व, दुग्धत्वं.
दुग्धतालीय: दुग्धतालीय n. (-यं) Milk and mangoes, mango fool. 2 The froth of milk, syllabub. 3 The skim of milk or cream. E. दुग्धता, लीङ् to embrace or adhere, affix छ.
दुग्धपाचन: दुग्धपाचन n. (-नं) A vessel for boiling milk. E. टुग्ध milk, and पाचन cooking.
दुग्धपुच्छी: दुग्धपुच्छी f. (-च्छी) A plant commonly Dugdhapeya. E. दुग्ध milk, and पुच्छ a tail.
दुग्धफेन: दुग्धफेन n. (-नं) The froth or skim of milk, syllabub, cream. f. (-नी) A small medicinal shrub, so called. E. दुग्ध milk, फेन froth, foam.
दुग्धाक्ष: दुग्धाक्ष m. (-क्षः) A sort of stone, (opal?) E. दुग्ध milk, and अक्ष a die, &c.
दुग्धाब्धि: दुग्धाब्धि n. (-ब्धिः) The sea of milk. E. दुग्ध, and अब्धि sea.
दुग्धाब्धितनया: दुग्धाब्धितनया f. (-या) A name of LAKṢMI. E. दुग्धाब्धि, and तनया daughter.
दुग्धिका: दुग्धिका f. (-का) A sort of Asclepias, (A. rosea, Rox.) (the Hindi derivative Dūdhi, is also applied to Euphorbia hirta and thymifolia. E. दुग्ध milk, and ठन् affix, and the feminine form; the leaves, &c. yielding a milky sap.
दुग्धिन्: दुग्धिन् mfn. (-ग्धी-ग्धिनी-ग्धि) Milky, having milk. E. दुग्ध, and इनि aff.
दुग्धिनिका: दुग्धिनिका f. (-का) A plant described as a red sort of Apang, (Achyranthes aspera.)
दुच्छक: दुच्छक f. (-कः) A kind of perfume: see मुरा.
दुडि: दुडि f. (-डिः) A small or female tortoise: see दुलि.
दुण्डुभ: दुण्डुभ m. (-भः) A kind of snake, one which is described as not venomous. E. द्रुभ to sink, Uṇādi affix उभ, deriv. irr.
दुद्: दुद् f. (-दुत् or दुद्) Anxiety, uneasiness. E. दु to give pain, affix क्विप्.
दुद्द: दुद्द mfn. (-द्दः-द्दा-द्दं) 1 Giving pain. 2 Wicked. E. दुद्, and द who or what gives.
दुद्यूषु: दुद्यूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to play with or brandish. E. दिव to play, desid. form irr., उ aff.
दुद्रुम: दुद्रुम m. (-मः) A green onion. E. दु bad, द्रुम tree; onions being prohibited food.
दुधूषत्: दुधूषत् mfn. (-षन्-षती-षत्) Trying to shake. E. धु to tremble, desid. form, शतृ aff.
दुन्दम: दुन्दम m. (-मः) A sort of drum. E. दु bad, ill, दम to subdue, affix अच्, नुम् augment.
दुन्दु: दुन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 A name of VASUDEVA, the father of KṚṢṆA. 3 A kind of drum. E. दु difficult, दस to tame, affix डु, and नुम् inserted.
दुन्दुभि: दुन्दुभि m. (-भिः) 1 A sort of large kettle drum. 2 A name of VARUṆA, regent of the ocean. The name of a Daitya or demon. 3 A pair or couple. f. (-भिः-भी) 1 A die or dice. 2 Twice three spots on a dice, or a pair of dice, with three spots on each. E. दुन्दु imitative sound, and भा to utter, affix कि, or द्यौ heaven, उभ to fill, and deriv. irr.
दुन्दुमार: दुन्दुमार m. (-रः) 1 A sort of red worm. 2 The smoke of a house. 3 A cat: other authorities have धुन्धुमार, q. v.
दुन्वत्: दुन्वत् mfn. (-न्वन्-न्वती-न्वत्) Afflicting, injuring. E. दु to injure, शतृ aff.
दुर्: दुर् ind. A depreciative particle, implying. 1 Pain, trouble, (bad, difficult, ill.) 2 Inferiority, (bad, vile, contemptible.) 3 Prohibition, (away, hold, forbear.) It corresponds in general to the English prefixes, in, un, &c. as in infamous, unbearable, and the like. E. दो to cut or divide, डुर affix. In composition, the final र is changed to visarga, and this to a sibilant optionally before the two first consonants of each class and the sibilants, as दुःकर, दुष्कर; and दुःसह, दुस्सह; or to र again before any other consonant or vowel, as दुर्ग, दुरतिक्रम &c. q. v.
दुरक्ष: दुरक्ष n. (-क्षं) A loaded or fraudulent die or dice. E. दुर्, and अक्ष a die.
दुरतिक्रम: दुरतिक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Difficult to be suppressed or overcome, insuperable, unconquerable. 2 Difficult of performance or accomplishment. E. दुर्, and अतिक्रम overcoming.
दुरत्यय: दुरत्यय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Difficult to be passed or overcome. E. दुर्, and अत्यय going over or beyond.
दुरदृष्ट: दुरदृष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Bad luck, misfortune. E. दुर्, and अदृष्ट fortune.
दुरधिगम: दुरधिगम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Difficult to be traversed. 2 Difficult to be read through or studied. 2 Insurmountable, difficult to be overcome. E. दुर्, and अधिगम going over.
दुरध्यय: दुरध्यय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 Difficult of attainment or of acquirement. 2 Difficult of perusal. E. दुर्, and अध्यय going over.
दुरध्व: दुरध्व m. (-ध्वः) A bad road. E. दुर् bad, अध्वन् a road, अच् substituted for the final syllable of the last member of the compound.
दुरन्त: दुरन्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) Ending ill, having a bad end. E. दुर्, and अन्त end.
दुरपचार: दुरपचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Difficult to be displeased or offended. E. दुर्, and अपचार offence.
दुरभिग्रह: दुरभिग्रह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Difficult to be taken or laid hold of. m. (-हः) A tree, (Achyranthes aspera.) f. (-हा) Cowach. E. दुर्, and अभिग्रह taking.
दुराक: दुराक m. (-कः) A barbarian. E. दुर् bad, vile, आक Uṇādi aff.
दुराक्राम: दुराक्राम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Difficult to be passed. 2 Invincible. E. दुर्, and आङ् before क्रम to go, अच् aff.
दुराचार: दुराचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Wicked, depraved, following evil practices. 2 Disregarding or deviating from established practices. m. (-रः) Wickedness. E. दुर् bad, आचार observance.
दुराढ्य: दुराढ्य mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं) Poor, not rich. E. दुर्, and आढ्य rich.
दुराढ्यकर: दुराढ्यकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Who does any thing with difficulty though rich. 2 What is done by one not rich. E. दुराढ्य, कृ to do, खल् aff.
दुराढ्यम्भव: दुराढ्यम्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) 1 Proceeding from one not rich. Produced with difficulty by one who is rich. E. दुराढ्य, भू to be, खल aff.
दुरात्मन्: दुरात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Vile, wicked, bad. m. (-त्मा) A rascal, a scoundrel, a villain. E. दुर्, and आत्मन् soul.
दुराधर्ष: दुराधर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Haughty, intractable. m. (-र्षः) Whitemustard. E. दुर्, and आधर्ष pride.
दुराधि: दुराधि mfn. (-धिः-धिः-धि) Painful, distressing. E. दुर्, and आधि affliction.
दुराप: दुराप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Difficult of attainment. E. दुर्, आप to obtain, क aff.
दुरारोह: दुरारोह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Of difficult ascent. m. (-हः) 1 The palm tree. 2 The date tree. f. (-हा) The silk cotton tree. E. दुर with difficulty, आरोह to be ascended, from रुह to rise, with आङ् prefixed, affixes अच् and टाप्.
दुरालभ: दुरालभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Unfit to be touched or taken, difficult of handling. 2 Difficult of attainment. f. (-भा) A prickly plant, commonly Javāsa, (Hedysarum alhagi.) E. दुर्, bad, hardly, लभ to attain, with आङ् prefixed, affix खल, fem. affix टाप्: see the next.
दुरालम्भा: दुरालम्भा f. (-म्भा) A plant, Javāsa: see the preceding. E. as above, नुम् optionally inserted.
दुरालाप: दुरालाप m. (-पः) Abuse, scurrilous or abusive language. E. दुर् bad, आलाप address.
दुरालोक: दुरालोक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Painfully bright, dazzling, not to be looked at. m. (-कः) Great brightness or splendour. E. दुर्, and आलोक seeing.
दुराशय: दुराशय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Difficult of shelter or asylum. E. दुर्, and आशय resting place.
दुरास: दुरास mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Difficult to be overcome or expelled. E. दुर्, and आस to sit, खल् aff.
दुरासद: दुरासद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Difficult of attainment. 2 Difficult of access. 3 Unequalled, unrivalled. 4 Intolerable. E. दुर् with difficulty, आङ् implying to or up to, सद to go, affix अच्.
दुरित: दुरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sinful, wicked. n. (-तं) Sin. E. दुर् vile, bad, इत gone, become.
दुरिष्ठ: दुरिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Very bad, very wicked. n. (-ष्ठं) Great crime, extreme wickedness. E. दुर् bad, vile, and इष्ठन् superlative aff.
दुरीषणा: दुरीषणा f. (-णा) 1 Curse, cursing. 2 An evil eye. E. दुर् bad, ईषणा seeing.
दुरुत्तर: दुरुत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Impassable, difficult to be crossed. 2 Unanswerable. E. दुर्, and उत्तर going over.
दुरुदाहर: दुरुदाहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Difficult to be articulated or pronounced. E. दुर्, and उदाहर pronouncing.
दुरुद्वह: दुरुद्वह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Burthensome, unbearable. E. दुर्, and उद्वह up-bearing.
दुरुपक्रम: दुरुपक्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Difficult of access or approach. 2 Difficult of cure. E. दुर्, and उपक्रम approach.
दुरुपचार: दुरुपचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Difficult of cure. 2 Unmanageable. E. दुर्, and उपचार implement.
दुरुपस्थान: दुरुपस्थान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Unapproachable, unattainable. E. दुर्, and उपस्थान proximity.
दुरोदर: दुरोदर m. (-रः) 1 A gamester. 2 A stake. n. (-रं) Playing, gaming. E. दुर् bad, reprehensible, उदर contest.
दुर्ग: दुर्ग mfn. (-र्गः-र्गा-र्गं) 1 Difficult of access or approach, inaccessible, impervious, impermeable. 2 Difficult of attainment, unattainable. n. (-र्गं) 1 A fort, a strong hold, a Droog or hill fort. 2 A pass, a defile, a difficult or narrow passage over a stream or a mountain, or through a wood, &c. m. (-र्गः) The name of an Asura slain by DURGĀ. f. (-र्गा) 1 The goddess DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA, and mother of KĀRTTIKEYA, and GAṆEŚA; also called UMĀ, and PĀRVATĪ, &c.: as DURGĀ, she is a goddess of terrific form, and irascible temper, and particularly worshipped at the DURGĀ Pūjā, held in Bengal in the month of Āśvina, or about October. 2 The indigo plant. 3 A creeping shrub, (Clitoria ternata.) 4 A singing bird, the Śyāmā. E. दुर् bad, ill, with difficulty, गम to go, affix ड; the etymology of the goddess is thus given, दुर् with difficulty, गम to be known; a knowledge of whom is obtained only by the severest austerities; or दुर् bad, गै to sing, who is especially hymned by the wicked; or दुर्ग the Asura slain by the goddess.
दुर्गकर्म्म: दुर्गकर्म्म mn. (-र्म्मः-र्म्मं) Enterprize, difficult undertaking. E. दुर्ग, and कर्म्म act.
दुर्गकारक: दुर्गकारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Making difficult or impassable. n. (-कं) The Bhojpatra or birch. E. दुर्ग an impervious thicket, and कारक making.
दुर्गत: दुर्गत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Poor, indigent, distressed. 2 Suffering pain or affliction. E. दुर ill, गत gone, become.
दुर्गति: दुर्गति f. (-तिः) 1 Hell. 2 Poverty, indigence. 3 A difficult path or site. E. दुर् bad, ill, गति going.
दुर्गतिनाशिनी: दुर्गतिनाशिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. दुर्गति hell, नाशिनी who destroys.

दुर्वासस्: दुर्व्वासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Ill dressed. m. (-साः) The name of a Ṛṣi or saint, the son of ATRI, and an incarnation or portion of ŚIVA, famous for his choleric temperament. E. दुर्, and वासस् vesture.
दुर्व्वासस्: दुर्व्वासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Ill dressed. m. (-साः) The name of a Ṛṣi or saint, the son of ATRI, and an incarnation or portion of ŚIVA, famous for his choleric temperament. E. दुर्, and वासस् vesture.
दुर्विध: दुर्व्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Poor, pauper, indigent. 2 Wicked, malevolent. 3 Foolish, stupid. E. दुर् bad, ill, विध habit, custom.
दुर्व्विध: दुर्व्विध mfn. (-धः-धा-धं) 1 Poor, pauper, indigent. 2 Wicked, malevolent. 3 Foolish, stupid. E. दुर् bad, ill, विध habit, custom.
दुर्विनीत: दुर्व्विनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ill mannered, ill trained or behaved. m. (-तः) A restive horse. E. दुर् with difficulty, विनीत led, managed.
दुर्व्विनीत: दुर्व्विनीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Ill mannered, ill trained or behaved. m. (-तः) A restive horse. E. दुर् with difficulty, विनीत led, managed.
दुर्विभाव्य: दुर्विभाव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) Incomprehensible, inconceivable. E. दुर्, and विभाव्य to be observed.
दुर्विवाह: दुर्विवाह m. (-हः) A bad mode or form of marriage. E. दुर्, and विवाह marriage.
दुर्विषह: दुर्विषह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Difficult to be sustained or supported. E. दुर्, and वि before सह to bear, affix अप्.
दुर्वृत्त: दुर्वृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Vile, wicked, leading a low or infamous life, following disreputable habits or business, a cheat, a juggler, a rogue, a blackguard, &c. E. दुर् bad, वृत to be or abide, affix क्त.
दुर्वृत्ति: दुर्वृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Leading a disreputable life, following a degrading business, &c. 2 Juggling, fraud. E. दुर्, and वृत्ति maintenance.
दुर्हन: दुर्हन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) What is killed with difficulty. E. दुर् before हन to kill, खल् aff.
दुर्हृद्: दुर्हृद् mfn. (-द् or त्) Inimical, ill-disposed. m. (-द् or त्) An enemy. E. दुर् bad, हृद् heart.
दुर्हृदय: दुर्हृदय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Evil-minded, bad-hearted. E. दुर् bad, ill, हृदय the heart.
दुल: दुल r. 10th cl. (दोलति) 1 To raise, to throw up. 2 To excite. 3 To shake, to swing.
दुलि: दुलि m. (-लिः) A Muni or saint. f. (-लिः or ली) A small or female tortoise. E. दुल to throw up, (mud, &c.) affix कि, fem. affix optionally ङीष्.
दुश्चर: दुश्चर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Going with trouble or difficulty. 2 Acting ill, behaving wickedly. 3 Unattainable. m. (-रः) 1 A bivalve shell. 2 A bear. E. दुर् bad, चर to go, अच् or टच् aff.
दुश्चरित: दुश्चरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Misbehaving, abandoned, wicked. m. (-तं) Misbehaviour, ill conduct, wickedness. E. दुर्, and चरित conduct.
दुश्चर्मन्: दुश्चर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A circumcised man, or one whose prepuce is naturally or artificially wanting. E. दुर् bad, difficult, चर्म्मन् skin.
दुश्चर्म्मन्: दुश्चर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्मा) A circumcised man, or one whose prepuce is naturally or artificially wanting. E. दुर् bad, difficult, चर्म्मन् skin.
दुश्चेष्टित: दुश्चेष्टित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Misbehaving, doing or designing evil. n. (-तं) Evil purpose or action, misconduct, error. E. दुर्, and चेष्टित exerted.
दुश्च्यवन: दुश्च्यवन m. (-नः) A name of INDRA. E. दुर् ill, च्यवन the name of a saint: INDRA having raised his arm to hurl his thunderbolt at Cyavana, had it fixed in that position by the curse of the saint; other etymologies are given.
दुश्छद: दुश्छद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Tattered, hardly covered. E. दुर्, and छद covering.
दुश्शासन: दुश्शासन m. (-नः) One of the Kaurava princes. E. दुर्, and शासन government.
दुष: दुष (इर, जौ) इरदुषौ r. 4th cl. (दुष्यति) 1 To do or act wrong or improperly. 2 To be impure. With प्र and आङ् prefixed, To become manifest or apparent.
दुष्कर: दुष्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) 1 Difficult to be done. 2 One who behaves ill, does wrong, &c. wicked, bad. n. (-रं) 1 Æther, atmosphere. 2 The tree of plenty. 3 Doing any thing with pain or difficulty. E. दुर् bad, and कर what does, from कृ with खल् aff.
दुष्कर्मन्: दुष्कर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Wickedness, sin. 2 Any difficult or painful act. E. दुर्, and कर्म्मन् act.
दुष्कर्म्मन्: दुष्कर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Wickedness, sin. 2 Any difficult or painful act. E. दुर्, and कर्म्मन् act.
दुष्कुल: दुष्कुल n. (-लं) A low family or race. E. दुर् bad, कुल race.
दुष्कुलीन: दुष्कुलीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of a low or degraded family. m. (-नः) A sort of perfume, commonly Chor. E. दुर् bad, कुलीन family or species.
दुष्कृत: दुष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Done wrong or wickedly. 2 Done with difficulty or pain. n. (-तं) Sin, crime, guilt. E. दुर् evil, कृत done, committed.
दुष्कृतकर्मन्: दुष्कृतकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Wicked, reprobate. n. (-र्म्म) Wickedness. E. दुष्कृत, and कर्म्मन् act.
दुष्कृतकर्म्मन्: दुष्कृतकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Wicked, reprobate. n. (-र्म्म) Wickedness. E. दुष्कृत, and कर्म्मन् act.
दुष्कृतवहिष्कृत: दुष्कृतवहिष्कृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Holy, free from sin. E. दुष्कृत, and वहिष्कृत excluded.
दुष्कृतिन्: दुष्कृतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Wicked, an evil doer. E. दुष्कृत, and इनि aff.
दुष्क्रम: दुष्क्रम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Difficult of access. 2 Going ill or laboriously. 3 Ill arranged, unmethodical. E. दुर्, and क्रम going.
दुष्क्रीत: दुष्क्रीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dear, bought too dearly or unadvisedly. E. दुर् bad, क्रीत purchased: a bad bargain.
दुष्ख: दुष्ख n. (-ष्खं) Pain in general: see दुःख.
दुष्ट: दुष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Low, vile. 2 Weak, impotent. 3 Wicked, depraved. 4 Spoiled, injured. 5 Violated. 6 Contaminated, degraded. 7 Worthless. f. (-ष्टा) A harlot, a wanton. n. (-ष्टं) A kind of Costus, (C. speciosus:) see कुष्ट. E. दुष to be corrupt, &c. affix क्त.
दुष्टचारिन्: दुष्टचारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Wicked. E. दुष्ट, and चारिन् practising.
दुष्टचेतस्: दुष्टचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ताः-तः) 1 Malevolent. 2 Stupid. E. दुष्ट, and चेतस् the heart or mind.
दुष्टता: दुष्टता f. (-ता) 1 Wickedness, badness. 2 Contamination, defilement. 3 Violation. E. तल् added to दुष्ट; also त्व, दुष्टत्वं.
दुष्टभाव: दुष्टभाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Innately bad. E. दुष्ट, and भाव nature.
दुष्टभावता: दुष्टभावता f. (-ता) Wickedness, innate depravity. E. दुष्टभाव, and तल् aff.
दुष्टमति: दुष्टमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Wicked, depraved. E. दुष्ट, and मति mind.
दुष्टवृष: दुष्टवृष m. (-षः) A lazy ox. E. दुष्ट as above, and वृष an ox.
दुष्टव्रण: दुष्टव्रण m. (-णः) A dull boil or sore, a sinus. E. दुष्ट bad, and व्रण sore.
दुष्टान्वित: दुष्टान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Defiled, rendered impure. E. दुष्ट, and possessed of.
दुष्ठु: दुष्ठु ind. 1 Ill, bad. 2 Improperly, incorrectly. mfn. (-ष्ठुः-ष्ठुः-ष्ठु) Ill behaved, unprincipled, depraved. E. दु ill, स्था to be, affix कु.
दुष्पत्र: दुष्पत्र m. (-त्रः) Cor, a perfume. E. दुर् bad, पत्र a leaf.
दुष्पर्श: दुष्पर्श mfn. (-र्शः-र्शा-र्शं) Not to be touched, unpleasant to the touch. m. (-र्शः) A plant, (Hedysarum alhaji:) see दुःस्पर्श.
दुष्पान: दुष्पान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Difficult to be drank. E. दुर्, and पान drinking.
दुष्प्रकृति: दुष्प्रकृति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Of a bad nature or disposition. E. दुर्, and प्रकृति nature.
दुष्प्रधर्षणी: दुष्प्रधर्षणी f. (-णी) The egg plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. दुर् with difficulty, प्र before धृष to show, to guide, affix ल्युट्; also with णिनि affix दुष्प्रधर्षिणी.
दुष्प्रधर्षा: दुष्प्रधर्षा f. (-र्षा) A plant, (Hedysarium alhaji.) 2 The date tree. E. दुर्, and प्र before धृष to guide, affix अङ्, and टाप्.
दुष्प्रमय: दुष्प्रमय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Immeasurable, difficult to be measured. E. दुर्, and प्र before मी to measure, खल् aff.
दुष्प्रलम्भ: दुष्प्रलम्भ mfn. (-म्भः-म्भा-म्भं) Difficult of attainment. E. दुर्, and प्र before लभ to gain, खल् affix, नुम् inserted.
दुष्प्राप: दुष्प्राप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Difficult of attainment, difficult to be got or reached. E. दुर्, and प्राप obtaining.
दुष्प्राप्य: दुष्प्राप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Remote, unattainable, difficult of approach or attainment. E. दुर्, and प्राप्य obtainable.
दुष्मन्त: दुष्मन्त m. (-न्तः) A prince of the lunar line, the husband of ŚAKUNTALĀ. E. दुर्, and झ affix, मुम् aug.; also read दुष्यन्त.
दुष्यन्त: दुष्यन्त m. (-न्तः) A prince: see the last. E. दुष to do wrong, झ aff.
दुस्तर: दुस्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Difficult to be crossed. E. दुर्, and तर crossing.
दुस्त्यज: दुस्त्यज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Difficult to be relinquished or parted with. E. दुर्, and त्यज abandoning.
दुस्सथ: दुस्सथ m. (-थः) 1 A dog. 2 A cock.
दुह: दुह (औ) दुहौ r. 2nd cl. (दोग्धि) 3rd pers. plu. (दुहन्ति) To milk. (इर) दुहिर r. 1st cl. (दोहति) 1 To hurt, to afflict, to give pain. 2 To kill.
दुह्: दुह् m. (धुक्) A milker. E. दुह, and क्विप् aff.
दुहत्: दुहत् mfn. (-हन्-हन्ती-हत्) 1 Relinquishing, parting with. 2 Milking. E. दुह to milk, शतृ aff.
दुहितुःपति: दुहितुःपति m. (-तिः) A son-in-law, a daughter's husband. E. दुहितृ a daughter, in the possessive case, and पति a husband.
दुहितृ: दुहितृ f. (-ता) A daughter. E. दुह to milk, (the mother,) Uṇādi affix तृच्, and इट् inserted.
दुह्य: दुह्य mfn. (-ह्यः-ह्या-ह्यं) To be milked, milkable. E. दुह to milk, affix क्यप्; also दोह्य.
दू: दू (ओ, ङ) ओदूङ् r. 4th cl. (दूयते) 1 To suffer or be consumed with pain. 2 To inflict pain or anxiety.
दू f. (दूः) Pain, distress. E. दू, and क्विप् aff.
दूडभ: दूडभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Unfortunate, distressed. E. दुर difficult, डम्भ to deceive, deriv. irr.
दूडाश: दूडाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Pained, afflicted. E. दुर bad, painful, दशि to hurt, deriv. irr.
दूढ्य: दूढ्य mfn. (-ढ्यः-ढ्या-ढ्यं) Bad, vile. E. दुर्, and ध्यै to meditate, deriv. irr.
दूणाश: दूणाश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Destroyed or annihilated with trouble or difficulty. E. दुर before, णश to destroy, deriv. irr.
दूत: दूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sent, despatched. m. (-तः) 1 A messenger or envoy, a news-carrier. 2 An ambassador. f. (-तिः-ती) A female messenger, a confidante, a procuress, a go-between, &c. E. दु to go, Uṇādi affix क्त, and the vowel made long; or दू to suffer, affix क्त, fem. affix क्तिन् or क्तिच्, and optionally ङीप्.
दूतघ्नी: दूतघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A plant, resembling the Kadamba: see कदम्बपुष्पी. E. दूत a messenger, घ्नी what destroys.
दूतिका: दूतिका f. (-का) A female messenger, a confidante, &c. see दूत, &c. E. कन् added to दूति; also with the penultimate vowel made long, दूतीका.
दूत्य: दूत्य n. (-त्यं) 1 An embassy, a message. 2 The abstract state or condition of a message or a messenger. E. दूत a messenger, and यत् aff.
दूद: दूद mfn. (दः-दा-दं) Afflicting, harassing. E. दू, and द what gives or occasions.
दून: दून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Suffering pain or fatigue. 2 Going, moving. 3 Shaken, agitated. E. दू to suffer, affix क्त.
दूनवत्: दूनवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Being agitated or distressed. 2 Gone, having gone. E. दू to be agitated, क्तवतु aff.
दूर: दूर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Distant, remote. n. adv. (-रं) Far, far off. 2 Widely, deeply. E. दुर with difficulty, इण् to go, Uṇādi affix रक्, deriv. irr.
दूरग: दूरग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Going a far or a long way. 2 Remote. E. दूर, and ग what goes.
दूरगामिन्: दूरगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going far. m. (-मी) An arrow, &c. E. दूर, and गामिन् what goes.
दूरतस्: दूरतस् ind. Afar, far off, from a distance, from afar. E. दूर, and तसि aff.
दूरता: दूरता f. (-ता) Remoteness, distance. E. दूर, and तल; also with त्व, दूरत्वं.
दूरदर्शन: दूरदर्शन n. (-नं) 1 Foresight. 2 Long-sightedness. m. (-नः) A vulture. E. दूर, and दर्शन seeing.
दूरदर्शिन्: दूरदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Long-sighted, far-seeing, (literally or metaphorically.) m. (-र्शी) 1 A Paṇḍita, a learned man, a teacher. 2 A prophet, a seer. 3 A vulture. E. दूर far, and दर्शिन् who sees, from दृश to see, with णिनि affix; also with क्विप् affix दूरदृश्.
दूरदृश्: दूरदृश् m. (-दृक्) 1 A learned man. 2 A vulture: see the preceding.
दूरदृष्टि: दूरदृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 Long-sightedness. 2 Foresight. E. दूर, and दृष्टि sight.
दूरपातिन्: दूरपातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) Far going. E. दूर, and पातिन् who goes.
दूरभाज्: दूरभाज् mfn. (-क् or ज्) Distant. E. दूर, and भाज् what shares.
दूरभिन्न: दूरभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Struck or wounded deeply. E. दूर, and भिन्न divided.
दूरयायिन्: दूरयायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Going far. E. दूर, and यायिन् what goes.
दूरवस्त्रक: दूरवस्त्रक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Naked, undressed. E. दूर, and वस्त्र clothes.
दूरवासिन्: दूरवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) Residing in a foreign land, outlandish. E. दूर, and वासिन् who or what abides.
दूरविभिन्न: दूरविभिन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Unconnected by the ties of nature, of a different nature. E. दूर, and विभिन्न separated.
दूरवेधिन्: दूरवेधिन् mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि) Missile, projectile, (weapons, &c.) E. दूर afar, and वेधिन् what pierces or wounds.
दूरसंस्थ: दूरसंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Remote, distant. E. दूर, and संस्थ what stays.
दूरसंस्थान: दूरसंस्थान n. (-नं) Being or residing at a distance. E. दूर, and संस्थान site.
दूरस्थ: दूरस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Remote, far off. E. दूर, and स्थ what stays or is; also दूरस्थित, and दूरस्थायिन्, &c.
दूराप्लाव: दूराप्लाव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Jumping far. E. दूर, and आप्लाव a leap.
दूरावस्थित: दूरावस्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Standing or being afar off. E. दूर, and अवस्थित situated.
दूरीकरण: दूरीकरण n. (-णं) Removing, placing at a distance. E. दूर, and करण making, च्चि aff.
दूरीकृत: दूरीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Removed, placed afar off. E. दूर, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
दूरीभूत: दूरीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Remote, far off. E. दूर, and भूत become, च्चि aff.
दूरेत्य: दूरेत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Far, distant. E. दूर, and एत्य aff.
दूरेरितेक्षण: दूरेरितेक्षण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Squint-eyed. E. दूर afar, ईरित sent, and ईक्षण sight.
दूर्बा: दूर्ब्बा f. (-र्ब्बा) Bent grass, commonly Dūb (Panicum dactylon.) E. दुर्ब्ब to hurt or be hurt, affix अच् or घञ्, fem. affix टाप्; what hurts sin, or is injured by cattle.
दूर्ब्बा: दूर्ब्बा f. (-र्ब्बा) Bent grass, commonly Dūb (Panicum dactylon.) E. दुर्ब्ब to hurt or be hurt, affix अच् or घञ्, fem. affix टाप्; what hurts sin, or is injured by cattle.
दूर्ब्बावण: दूर्ब्बावण n. (-णं) A thicket of Dūb grass. E. दूर्ब्बा, and वन wood; also with the final unchanged, दूर्ब्बावन.
दूर्य: दूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Fæces, ordure. E. दूर far, या to go, affix ड.
दूर्य्य: दूर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Fæces, ordure. E. दूर far, या to go, affix ड.
दूश्य: दूश्य n. (-श्यं) A tent: see दूष्य.
दूष: दूष r. 4th cl. (दूष्यति) 1 To be or become bad. 2 To make bad.
दूषक: दूषक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Ill, low, contemptible, infamous. 2 Spoiling, corrupting, contaminating, who or what does so. E. दूष to be vile, affix क.
दूषण: दूषण m. (-णः) A Rākṣasa, the brother of RĀVAṆA. n. (-णं) 1 Blame, fault, defect, offence. 2 Spoiling, ruining, vitiating, defiling. 3 Violating, (as a girl.) 4 Breaking, (as an agreement.) E. दूष to become vile or wicked, affix युच्.
दूषणारि: दूषणारि m. (-रिः) RĀMA. E. दूषण the brother of RĀVAṆA, and अरि a foe.
दूषयाण: दूषयाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Vitiating, defiling, spoiling. E. दूष to make bad, शानच् aff.
दूषि: दूषि f. (-षिः-षी) The rheum of the eyes. E. दूष to make bad, affix कि or क with डीष् added; also दूषिका and दूषीका.
दूषिका: दूषिका f. (-का) 1 The rheum of the eyes. 2 A pencil or painting brush. E. दूष to make bad, (the eyes, &c.) affix ण्वुल्, fem. form; also दूषी, दूषि, and दूषीका.
दूषित: दूषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Calumniated, falsely accused, especially of adultery. 2 Contaminated, corrupted, spoiled. 3 Violated. 4 Blamed, censured. f. (-ता) A girl who has been violated or deflowered. E. दूष to become or make bad, affix क्त.
दूषीका: दूषीका f. (-का) The secretion or rheum of the eyes. E. दूष to hurt, (the eyes,) Uṇādi affix ईकन्: see दूषिका.
दूषीविष: दूषीविष n. (-षं) Poison that may be overcome by drugs or charms, or that does not act upon the system. E. दूषी rheum, and विष venom.
दूष्य: दूष्य mfn. (-ष्यः-ष्या-ष्यं) Reprehensible, contemptible, vile, bad. f. (-ष्या) An elephant's leathern girth. n. (-ष्यं) 1 Clothes. 2 A tent. 3 Pus, matter. E. दूष to be or become wicked or bad, यत् or ण्यत् affix, fem. affix टाप्.
दृ: दृ r. 6th cl. usually with आङ् prefixed (आद्रियते) To reverence, to revere, to respect. r. 5th cl. (दृणोति) To hurt or kill. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दरति दारयति) To fear, to be afraid.
दृंहित: दृंहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grown, increased. E. दृहि to increase, क्त affix.
दृकाण: दृकाण m. (-णः) A demigod, presiding over the third part of a sign of the zodiac, (in Astrology.)
दृक्कर्ण: दृक्कर्ण (-र्णः) A snake. E. दृश् an eye, and कर्ण an ear; whose eyes are his ears; in the opinion of the Hindus, the snake has no visible external ear.
दृक्प्रिया: दृक्प्रिया f. (-या) 1 Beauty. 2 Splendor. E. दृश्, and प्रिय grateful to.
दृक्श्रुति: दृक्श्रुति m. (-तिः) A snake. E. दृश an eye, and श्रुति the ear: see दृक्कर्ण.
दृगध्यक्ष: दृगध्यक्ष m. (-क्षः) The sun. E. दृश् the sight, त्र्यध्यक्ष ruler.
दृग्गोल: दृग्गोल m. (-लः) A small circle on the axis of the earth, within the greater circle of the armillary sphere, and accompanying each planetary circle. E. दृश्, and गोल circle.
दृग्विष: दृग्विष m. (-षः) A serpent or other such venomous reptile. E. दृश eye, and विष poison; whose eye is venomous.
दृङ्मण्डल: दृङ्मण्डल n. (-लं) A small circle within the great circles of the armillary sphere, accompanying each planetary circle or orbit. E. दृश, and मण्डल sphere.
दृडक: दृडक m. (-कः) A fire-place, or hole made in the ground for cooking.
दृढ: दृढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं) 1 Much, exceeding; (in this sense it is also an adverb declinable in the neuter gender.) 2 Hard, firm. 3 Able, powerful. 4 Bulky, massive, solid. 5 Strong. 6 Confirmed. n. (-ढं) Iron. E. दृह to increase, affix क्त.
दृढकण्टक: दृढकण्टक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Dhaliākāra. E. दृढ much or many, and कण्टक a thorn.
दृढकाण्ड: दृढकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A bambu. E. दृढ, and काण्ड a stem.
दृढकारिन्: दृढकारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Persevering, determined. E. दृढ, and कारिन् who does, (any act.)
दृढगात्रिका: दृढगात्रिका f. (-का) Granulated sugar. E. दृढ firm. गात्र substance, affix कन्.
दृढग्रन्थि: दृढग्रन्थि m. (-न्थिः) A bambu. E. दृढ, and ग्रन्थि a knot.
दृढता: दृढता f. (-ता) 1 Firmness, hardness. 2 Steadiness. 3 Solidity. 4 Strength. E. तल् added to दृढ; also with त्व, दृढत्वं.
दृढदंशक: दृढदंशक m. (-कः) A shark. E. दृड hard, दंशक a biter.
दृढधन्वन्: दृढधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) A good archer. E. दृढ, and धन्वन् a bow.
दृढधुर्: दृढधुर् mfn. (-धूः-धूः-धु) Strong, able to bear a weight or load. E. दृढ, and धुर् a burthen.
दृढनिश्चय: दृढनिश्चय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Certain, confirmed, corroborated, undoubted. E. दृढ, and निश्चय certainty.
दृढफल: दृढफल m. (-लः) The cocoanut. E. दृढ hard, and फल fruit.
दृढबद्ध: दृढबद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Bound or tied tightly. E. दृढ, and वद्ध bound.
दृढबन्धिनी: दृढबन्धिनी f. (-नी) A creeper, (Echites frutescens.) E. दृढ firmly, वन्ध to bind, affixes णिनि, and ङीप्; winding closely round a tree or stem.
दृढभक्ति: दृढभक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-क्तिः-क्ति) Faithful, devoted. E. दृढ, and भक्ति faith.
दृढमुष्टि: दृढमुष्टि mfn. (-ष्टिः-ष्टिः-ष्टि) Miserly, niggardly, close-fisted, m. (-ष्टिः) A sword, any weapon with a hilt or handle. E. दृढ firm, and मुष्टि a handle, a fist.
दृढमूल: दृढमूल m. (-लः) The cocoanut. E. दृढ hard, and मूल root.
दृढलोमन्: दृढलोमन् mfn. (-मा-मा-मं) Having coarse hair on the skin. m. (-मा) 1 A wild hog. 2 Coarse hair, bristles. E. दृढ firm, stiff, and लोमन् the hair of the body.
दृढव्रत: दृढव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Observing steadily a religious vow or obligation. E. दृढ, and व्रत a vow.
दृढसन्धि: दृढसन्धि mfn. (-न्धिः-न्धिः-न्धि) 1 Strong knit, well fixed or compact, (the person, &c.) 2 Close, compact, free from interstices. 3 Closely connected or allied. E. दृढ firm, and सन्धि union, a joint, &c.
दृढसूत्रिका: दृढसूत्रिका f. (-का) A plant from the fibres of which bow strings are made: see मूर्व्वा. E. दृढ firm, and सूत्र a thread, a fibre, affix क.
दृढसौहृद: दृढसौहृद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Firm in friendship, constant. E. दृढ, and सौहृद friendship.
दृढस्कन्ध: दृढस्कन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, a sort of Mimusops: see क्षीरिका. E. दृढ firm, and स्कन्ध stem.
दृढाङ्ग: दृढाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गा-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Firm-bodied, hard, strong. n. (-ङ्गं) A diamond. E. दृढ, and अङ्ग body.
दृढार्त्ति: दृढार्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 The end of a bow. 2 Great pain. E. दृढ, and अर्त्ति end of a bow, &c.
दृढाभक्ति: दृढाभक्ति f. (-क्तिः) A faithful mistress or wife. E. दृढ fem. form, and भक्ति attachment.
दृढायुध: दृढायुध m. (-धः) A hero, one firm in battle. E. दृढ, and आयुध war.
दृत: दृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Respected, honoured. f. (-ता) Cumin. E. दृ to respect, affix क्त.
दृति: दृति m. (-तिः) 1 A bellows. 2 A fish. 3 A skin of leather, or a leather bag for holding water. 4 Skin, hide. E. दॄ to divide, क्तिन् aff.
दृतिधारक: दृतिधारक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Acanpāta. E. दृति a bellows, and धारक having; having leaves compared to a leather bellows.
दृतिहरि: दृतिहरि m. (-रिः) A dog. E. दृति here said to mean skin in general, and हरि who steals, from हृ with इन् aff.
दृतिहार: दृतिहार m. (-रः) A carrier of skins or bags, a water carrier, &c. E. दृति, and हृ to take, अण् aff.
दृन्भू: दृन्भू m. (-न्भूः) 1 The thunderbolt. 2 The sun. f. (-न्भूः) 1 A snake in general. 2 A wheel. E. दृभ to fear, Uṇādi affix कू, and नुम् inserted; न being optionally changed to म before भ, the word is also read दृम्भू.
दृप: दृप r. 4th cl. (ञि ईर ऊ) ञि ईरदृपु (दृप्यति) 1 To be glad, to rejoice. 2 To be arrogant, to be vain or proud. r. 6th cl. (दृपति) To pain, to inflict pain, to torture. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दर्पति दर्पयति) To light, to kindle or inflame.
दृप्त: दृप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Proud, arrogant. E. दृप to be proud, affix क्त.
दृप्यत्: दृप्यत् mfn. (-प्यन्-प्यती-प्यत्) Being proud or arrogant. E. दृप to be proud, शतृ aff.
दृप्र: दृप्र mfn. (-प्रः-प्रा-प्रं) 1 Strong, powerful. 2 Proud, arrogant. E. दृप to be proud, Uṇādi affix रक्.
दृफ: दृफ r. 6th cl. (दृफति) To pain, to hurt.
दृब्ध: दृब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) 1 Strung, tied. 2 Afraid, frightened. 3 Pained, tortured. E. दृभ to pain, to string, affix क्त.
दृभ: दृभ (ई) दृभी r. 6th cl. (दृभति) 1 To string, to arrange. 2 To give pain. r. 1st and 10th cls. (दर्भति दर्भयति) To fear, to be afraid.
दृम्प: दृम्प r. 6th cl. (दृम्पति) To inflict pain, to torture.
दृम्फ: दृम्फ r. 6th cl. (दृम्फति) To pain, to torture.
दृम्फू: दृम्फू f. (-म्फूः) A snake in general. E. दृम्फ to give pain, affix कूः see दृम्भू.
दृम्भू: दृम्भू f. (-म्भूः) A snake, &c.: see दृम्भ.
दृश: दृश (औ ईर) औदृशिर r. 1st cl. (पश्यति) To see. With उत् prefixed, 1 To see, to observe. 2 To anticipate, to foresee. 3 To doubt, to think doubtingly.
दृश्: दृश् mfn. (-दृक्) 1 A seer, a looker. 2 Wise, possessed of knowledge. f. (-दृक्) 1 The eye. 2 Sight, seeing. E. दृश to see, affix क्विप्; also दृशा and दृशि, &c.
दृशद्: दृशद् f. (-शद् or शत्) 1 A stone, a rock. 2 A flat stone for grinding condiments upon. E. दॄ to divide, Uṇādi affix अदि, augment षुक्, and ष changed to श; the crude form may also be दृषत् or दृषट्, &c.
दृशद्वती: दृशद्वती f. (-ती) 1 The name of a river which forms the eastern boundary of the Āryavarta or holy land of the Hindus, running on the north-east of Delhi. 2 A name of the goddess DURGĀ. E. दृशद् a stone or rock, and मतुप् poss. aff.
दृशा: दृशा f. (-शा) The eye. E. see दृश, टाप् being here added.
दृशाकाङ्क्ष्य: दृशाकाङ्क्ष्य n. (-ङ्क्ष्य) A lotus, or rather a kind of nelumbium. E. दृश the eye, काङ्क्ष्य to desire, with आङ् prefix, and यत् affix; desirable as an object of comparison to the eye.
दृशान: दृशान n. (-नं) Light. m. (-नः) 1 The name of an Asura; also VIROCANA. 2 A holy or spiritual teacher. 3 A king, a ruler, a protector or cherisher of the world. 4 A Brahman. E. दृश to see, आनच् Uṇādi affix; by whom or which sight, &c. is enjoyed.
दृशि: दृशि f. (-शिः or शी) The eye. 2 A Śāstra. E. दृश to see, affix कि, ङीष् is optionally added.
दृशोपम: दृशोपम n. (-मं) The white lotus, (Nelumbium speciosum.) E. दृशा the eye, उपमा resemblance; what resembles the eye.
दृश्य: दृश्य mfn. (-श्यः-श्या-श्यं) 1 Visible, to be seen. 2 Beautiful, pleasing. m. (-श्यः) (In Arithmetic,) A given quantity or number. E. दृश to see, यत् aff.
दृश्यत्व: दृश्यत्व n. (-त्वं) Vision, sight. E. त्व added to the last.
दृषद्: दृषद् f. (-षद् or षत्) 1 A stone or rock. 2 A flat stone or plate on which spices, &c. are ground. E. दॄ to divide, Uṇādi affix अदि, and षुक् augment; also दृशद्.
दृष्ट: दृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Seen, visible, apparent. n. (-ष्टं) Obvious danger or calamity. E. दृश to see, affix क्त.
दृष्टकूट: दृष्टकूट n. (-टं) A riddle, an enigma. E. दृष्ट seen, कूट trick.
दृष्टदोष: दृष्टदोष mfn. (-षः-षा-षं) Found out, exposed, detected. E. दृष्ट, and दोष fault.
दृष्टरजस्: दृष्टरजस् f. (-जाः) A girl arrived at puberty. E. दृष्ट seen, (by whom,) and रजस् the menstrual discharge.
दृष्टवत्: दृष्टवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Seeing, beholding, having seen. E. दृश to see, क्तवतु aff.
दृष्टान्त: दृष्टान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A science, a Śāstra. 2 An example, an illustration. 3 Death, dying. E. दृष्ट obvious or seen, and अन्त end.
दृष्टि: दृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 The eye. 2 Sight, seeing. 3 Knowledge, wisdom. 4 The sight of the eye, the pupil. 5 Aspect, (of the stars.) E. दृश to see, affix क्तिन्.
दृष्टिकृत्: दृष्टिकृत् n. (-कृत्) A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis.) E. दृष्टि the eye, कृ to make, here meaning resemble; affix क्विप् and तुक् added; also with क्त affix दृष्टिकृत n. (-तं.)
दृष्टिगुण: दृष्टिगुण m. (-णः) A butt, a mark for archers, &c. E. दृष्टि the eye, and गुण object.
दृष्टिनिपात: दृष्टिनिपात m. (-तः) A look, a look at or on. E. दृष्टि, and निपात alighting.
दृष्टिपात: दृष्टिपात m. (-तः) A look, a glance. E. दृष्टि, and पात falling.
दृष्टिपूत: दृष्टिपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Kept pure by the sight, i. E. watched, that no impropriety is committed, or impurity contracted. E. दृष्टि, and पूत purified.
दृष्टिबन्धु: दृष्टिबन्धु m. (-न्धुः) A fire-fly. E. दृष्टि sight, and बन्धु a friend.
दृष्टिविक्षेप: दृष्टिविक्षेप m. (-पः) A leer, a side glance. E. दृष्टि the eye, विक्षेप casting.
दृष्टिविष: दृष्टिविष m. (-षः) A snake. E. दृष्टि, and विष poison, venomous in his look.
दृष्ट्वा: दृष्ट्वा ind. Having seen. E. दृश to see, क्त्वा aff.
दृह: दृह r. 1st cl. (दर्हति) also (इ) दृहि r. 1st cl. (दृंहति) To grow, to increase, to prosper.
दृहित: दृहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Grown, increased, thriven. E. दृह to grow, affix क्त with इट् inserted; also from दृहि, दृहित.
दॄ: दॄ r. 9th cl. (दृणाति) To tear, to rend, to divide or pull to pieces. r. 1st cl. (दरति) To fear, to dread.
दे: दे (ङ) देङ् r. 1st cl. (दयते) To preserve, to cherish or protect.
देदीप्यमान: देदीप्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Shining repeatedly or intensely, glowing, blazing. E. दीप to kindle, intens. form, शानच् aff.
देय: देय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be given, fit or proper for a gift. E. दा to give, यत् affix, and the vowel changed.
देव: देव (ऋ) देष्ट r. 1st cl. (देवते) To sport or play.

देव m. (-वः) 1 A deity, a god. 2 A king, in poetical language. 3 A husband's brother: see देवृ. 4 A cloud. 5 A fool, a dolt. 6 A child. 7 A man following any particular line or business. 8 A spear-man, a lancer. 9 Emulation, wish to excel or overcome. 10 Sport, play. 11 A term or surname applicable to a Brahman; also to a man of the Kayeth class. n. (-वं) An organ of sense. f. (-वा) 1 A flower, (Hibiscus mutabilis). 2 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) f. (-वी) 1 A goddess, the wife of any deity or divine being. 2 A name very commonly applied to the goddess DURGĀ. 3 A queen, one who has been consecrated as well as the king, (in theatrical language chiefly.) 4 A respectful epithet or title applied to a woman of the first class. 5 Worship, reverence. 6 A plant, (Trigonella corniculata:) 7 Another plant: see मूर्व्वा. E. दिव to play, (in heaven, &c.) affix अच्, fem. affix टाप् and ङीष्.
देवक: देवक mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं) 1 Who or what sports or plays. 2 Divine, celestial, like a deity. m. (-कः) A proper name, the maternal grandfather of KṚṢṆA. E. दिव to play, ण्वुल् affix; or देव, and कन् aff.
देवकर्दम: देवकर्द्दम m. (-मः) A fragrant paste of sandal, agallochum, camphor, and safflower. E. देव, and कर्द्दम mud.
देवकर्द्दम: देवकर्द्दम m. (-मः) A fragrant paste of sandal, agallochum, camphor, and safflower. E. देव, and कर्द्दम mud.
देवकात्मजा: देवकात्मजा f. (-जा) The mother of KṚṢṆA. E. देवक as above, and आत्मजा daughter.
देवकार्य: देवकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Worship of, or oblations to the gods. E. देव, and कार्य्य business.
देवकार्य्य: देवकार्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Worship of, or oblations to the gods. E. देव, and कार्य्य business.
देवकाष्ठ: देवकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) A kind of pine: (Pinus devadaru.) E. देव divine, and काष्ठ wood.
देवकिरी: देवकिरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of the modes of music.
देवकी: देवकी f. (-की) DEVAKĪ, the daughter of DEVAKA, wife of VASUDEVA, and mother of KṚṢṆA. E. देवक, अञ् patronymick affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also with the vowel changed by the affix, दैवकी.
देवकीनन्दन: देवकीनन्दन m. (-नः) A name of KṚṢṆA. E. देवकी as above, and नन्दन a son.
देवकीय: देवकीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Divine, belonging or relating to a divinity. E. देव, and छ aff.
देवकीसूनु: देवकीसूनु m. (-नुः) The deity KṚṢṆA. E. देवकी as above, and सूनु a son; also similar compounds, as देवकीनन्दन, and देवकीपुत्र.
देवकुण्ड: देवकुण्ड n. (ण्डं) A natural spring. E. देव, and कुण्ड a well.
देवकुल: देवकुल n. (-लं) A temple. E. देव a god, and कुल a house.
देवकुसुम: देवकुसुम n. (-मं) Cloves. E. देव a deity, and कुसुम a flower; fit for a deity.
देवखात: देवखात mfn. (-तं) 1 A cave or hollow among mountains. 2 A natural pond or reservoir. E. देव a deity, and खात dug; not the work of men.
देवखातक: देवखातक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 A natural pond or one in front of a temple. 2 A natural cavern, a grotto. E. देव a deity, खात dug, and कन् affix; dug by divine hands, or in honour of a god.
देवखातविल: देवखातविल n. (-लं) A cavern, a chasm. E. देवखात, and विल a hole.
देवगान्धारी: देवगान्धारी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs, or female personifications of the modes of music.
देवगायन: देवगायन m. (-नः) A Gandharba, a celestial quirister. E. देव a god, and गायन a singer.
देवगिरी: देवगिरी f. (-री) One of the female personifications of music.
देवगुरु: देवगुरु m. (-रुः) A name of VṚHASPATI. E. देव, and गुरु teacher; the preceptor of the gods.
देवगृह: देवगृह n. (-हं) 1 A celestial or planetary sphere, the dwelling of the gods. 2 A temple. E. देब, and गृह house.
देवचिकित्सक: देवचिकित्सक m. du. (-कौ) The two sons of AŚVINĪ, and physicians of heaven. E. देव a god, and चिकित्सक a physician.
देवच्छन्द: देवच्छन्द m. (-न्दः) A garland or necklace of pearls, &c. composed of 100 or 103 strings. E. देव a deity, and छदि to cover, affix घञ्.
देवजग्ध: देवजग्ध n. (-ग्धं) A fragrant grass. E. देव a deity, and जग्ध eaten.
देवजग्धक: देवजग्धक n. (-कं) A fragrant grass. E. कन् pleonastic, added to the preceding.
देवट: देवट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) An artist, an artisan. E. दिव to sport, अटन् Uṇādi aff.
देवट्टी: देवट्टी f. (-ट्टी) A sort of gull, (Larus ridibundus.)
देवतरु: देवतरु m. (-रुः) The holy fig tree. 2 A tree of Svarga or paradise, the Mandāra tree. 3 The tree of plenty. 4 Any venerable and ancient tree; usually the place of assembling in a village. E. देव a deity, and तरु a tree.
देवता: देवता f. (-ता) 1 A god, a deity or divine being. 2 Divinity: see देवत्व. E. देव divine, तल् affix of the abstract: in the first case, अन् added; of whom the attribute is divinity.
देवतागार: देवतागार m. (-रः) A temple. E. देवता, and आगार a house.
देवताड: देवताड m. (-डः) 1 A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.) 2 A name of Rāhu, the personified ascending node. 3 A name of fire. 4 A sort of creeper: see घोषक. E. देव a deity, &c. तड to torment, affix अण्.
देवताडक: देवताडक m. (-कः) A grass: see the preceding. E. कन् added to देवताड.
देवताधिप: देवताधिप m. (-पः) A name of INDRA. E. देवता a deity, अधिप ruler or chief.
देवताभ्यर्चन: देवताभ्यर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping an idol. E. देवता, and अभ्यर्च्चन worshipping.
देवताभ्यर्च्चन: देवताभ्यर्च्चन n. (-नं) Worshipping an idol. E. देवता, and अभ्यर्च्चन worshipping.
देवतायतन: देवतायतन n. (-नं) A temple. E. देवता, and आयतन dwelling.
देवतीर्थ: देवतीर्थ n. (-र्थं) The part of the hand sacred to the gods, the tips of the fingers. E. देव, and तीर्थ a shrine.
देवत्व: देवत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Divinity, the abstract attribute of divine being. 2 Identification with a deity, deification. E. देव a deity, and त्व abstract affix; also with तल्, देवता.
देवदत्त: देवदत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Given by the gods, god-given. m. (-त्तः) 1 The younger brother of the legislator Buddha. 2 The conch of ARJUNA. 3 One of the vital airs, that which is exhaled in yawning.
