द्वैतवादिन्: द्वैतवादिन् m. (-दी) A philosopher who asserts two principles. E. द्वैत, and वादिन् who asserts.
द्वैतीयीक: द्वैतीयीक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Second. E. द्वितीय second, pleonastick affix अण्, and ईकक् added.
द्वैध: द्वैध mfn. (-धः-धी-धं) Two-fold, of two sorts. n. (-धं) 1 A double resource, a stratagem, a secondary arrangement or array, a reserve. 2 Contest, dispute, difference. 3 A two-fold form or state. E. द्वैधम्, and ड added.
द्वैधम्: द्वैधम् ind. In two ways. E. द्वि, and धमुञ् aff.
द्वैधीकरण: द्वैधीकरण n. (-णं) Making two, separating, disuniting. E. द्वैध, and करण making, च्चि augment.
द्वैधीकृत: द्वैधीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Separated. 2 Made into two, sundered. E. द्वैध, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
द्वैधीभाव: द्वैधीभाव m. (-वः) 1 Sowing dissension, causing the separation of allies. 2 Dividing into two. 3 The nature or property of being two or distinct. E. द्वैध, and भाव property, च्चि aff.
द्वैधीभूत: द्वैधीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Being two, being separated or disunited. E. द्वैध, and भूत become, च्चि augment.
द्वैप: द्वैप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) 1 Made of a tiger's skin. 2 Island, islander. m. (-पः) A car covered or hung with a tiger's skin. E. द्वीप a tiger's skin, and अञ् aff.
द्वैपायन: द्वैपायन m. (-नः) A name of VYĀSA, the author or compiler of the Vedas and Purāṇas. E. द्वीप an island, फक् affix; the island-born, the place of his nativity being a small island in the Ganges.
द्वैप्य: द्वैप्य mfn. (-प्यः-प्या-प्यं) Of or belonging to an island. E. द्वीप an island, यञ् aff.
द्वैमातुर: द्वैमातुर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Having two mothers, or the natural mother and a step-mother. m. (-रः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 An epithet of JARĀSANDHA: see जरासन्ध. E. द्वि two, मातृ a mother, अण् affix, उ substituted for the penultimate: see द्विमातृज.
द्वैमित्रि: द्वैमित्रि mfn. (-त्रिः-त्री-त्ति) Born of two friends, the children, &c. E. द्वि, and मित्र a friend, इञ् aff.
द्वैयह्निक: द्वैयह्निक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to two days. E. द्व्यहन्, and ठञ् aff.
द्वैरथ: द्वैरथ m. (-थः) Single combat in chariots. E. द्विरथ two cars, अण् aff.
द्वैरात्रिक: द्वैरात्रिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to a period of two nights. E. द्विरात्र, and ठञ् aff.
द्वैवर्षिक: द्वैवर्षिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) After two years, of or belonging to two years to come. E. द्वि, वर्ष a year, ठञ् aff.
द्वैविध्य: द्वैविध्य n. (-ध्यः) The state of being two-fold. E. द्विविध, and ष्यञ् aff.
द्वैहायन: द्वैहायन n. (-नं) The age of two years. E. द्विहायन, and अण् aff.
द्व्यंश: द्व्यंश m. (-शः) Two shares. E. द्वि, and अंश part.
द्व्यक्षर: द्व्यक्षर n. (-रं) A word of two syllables. E. द्वि, and अक्षर a syllable.
द्व्यङ्गुल: द्व्यङ्गुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Measuring two fingers. n. (-लं) Two fingers. E. द्वि two, अङ्गुलि a finger; if wood is implied, the fem. form is द्व्यङ्गुली.
द्व्यञ्जल: द्व्यञ्जल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Measuring, &c. two Añjalis. n. (-लिः) Two Añjalis collectively. E. द्वि, and अञ्जलि a certain measure, टच् affix; also with the final retained द्व्यञ्जलि.
द्व्यणुक: द्व्यणुक n. (-कं) The aggregation of two atoms, the first step in the formation of substances, and when they become perceptible. E. द्वि, and अणु an atom, कन् added.
द्व्यन्य: द्व्यन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Accompanied, &c. by two others. n. (-न्यं) Two others collectively. E. द्धि, and अन्य another.
द्व्यर्थ: द्व्यर्थ mfn. (-र्थः-र्था-र्थं) 1 Having two senses, meaning two things. 2 Having two objects. m. (-र्थः) Two-fold meaning, double-entendre. E. द्वि, and अर्थ sense.
द्व्यष्ट: द्व्यष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Copper. E. द्वि two, (metals; gold and silver,) अश to pervade, affix क्त; mixed as alloy with the fine metals; also the य being interchanged with its congener इ, द्विष्ट.
द्व्यह: द्व्यह m. (-हः) Two days. E. द्वि two, and अह a day.
द्व्यहीन: द्व्यहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Of or belonging to two days. E. द्व्यह, and ख aff.
द्व्यात्मक: द्व्यात्मक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Comprising two, being two. m. (-कः) A sign of the zodiac, Gemini, Virgo, Sagittarius, and Pisces. E. द्वि, and आत्मन् self, कन् aff.
द्व्यामुषायण: द्व्यामुषायण m. (-णः) A boy who remains heir to his father though adopted by another. E. द्वि, and आमुष्यायण a certain person.
द्व्यायुष: द्व्यायुष n. (-षं) Two lives. E. द्वि, and आयुस life.
द्व्याहिक: द्व्याहिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Produced, &c. in two days. E. द्व्याह, and ठञ् aff.
द्व्येकान्तर: द्व्येकान्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Having two between, two off. E. द्वि, and एकान्तर an interval, च a line. ध
